scripts.text: Cannot proceed with the quest. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 物品欄已滿，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
Traveling at such confusing times?
Villagers have been feeling more threatened by evil spirits recently.
Villagers are scared and trembling with fear.
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
這種時候還要出門旅行嗎？
最近邪靈作祟，村民們越發憂心忡忡，個個都嚇得發抖。

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
So... the citizens of Port Malaya will feel uncomfortable around you even though there are no hard feelings toward you.
Inns and stops may be closed to outsiders.
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
所以......即使你並無惡意，馬來港的居民還是會對你心存戒備。
旅店和驛站也可能不接待外來者。

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
There is no definite solution to this, but you might want to meet Phong in Mumbaki first.
If the village leader gives his confirmation, other people might be less worried.
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
目前還沒有確切的解決辦法。你可以先去找蒙巴基的豐。
如果村長能確認你的身份，其他人或許就不會那麼擔心了。

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
I will mark on the map the location of Phong in Mumbaki.
I welcome your visit though the times are harsh.
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
我會在地圖上標出蒙巴基豐的位置。
時局雖艱難，我仍歡迎你來訪。

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
Meet with Phong in Mumbaki first.
If you are proven to have a pure soul, other villagers will not avoid you.
If you are not sure of the location, I will mark it on your map.
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
先去見見蒙巴基的豐吧。
只要證明你心地純良，其他村民就不會再躲著你。
找不到地方的話，我可以在地圖上標出來。

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
How is the life here?
People aren't so bad are they?
If you were a little more skillful, there might be a job for you. Right now, you are little bit below the standard.
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
在這裡過得怎麼樣？大家還不錯吧？
如果你的本事再強些，也許我能給你安排工作。眼下嘛，你還差一點。

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
If you become stronger,
I was thinking of giving you the extermination mission that's being carried out in the city. What a shame.
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
要是你再強一些，我本想把城裡正在進行的討伐任務交給你。真可惜。

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
Whew, thanks to you, I have one less thing to worry about.
I will lose less of my things.
Job well done.
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
呼，多虧了你，我總算少操一樁心。
這樣一來，我的東西也不容易再丟了。
幹得好。

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
You can come back if you want.
You understand what I mean right?
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
想回來的話，隨時都可以。
你懂我的意思吧？

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
Oh, about Jejeling that you hunted down before.
People traveling in and out of Baryo are happy about it.
If it's not much too much trouble, I'd like to ask for your help one more time.
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
對了，之前你討伐了食人波利，巴里奧一帶進出的商販都很高興。
不太麻煩的話，我想再請你幫一次忙。

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
You don't have to do it now, just whenever you are comfortable.
Come and find me when you decide.
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
不必現在就答應，等你方便時再說。
決定好了就來找我。

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
Oh yes, there is a job for you if you are not too busy. Are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
對了，你要是不忙，我這裡有份工作。感興趣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
Recently among visitors, one became a close friend to me. Do you know {0}? Oh, of course you are a good friend as well.
Oh yes, there is a job for you if you are not too busy. Are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
最近有個訪客和我成了好朋友。你認識{0}嗎？當然，你也是我的好朋友。
對了，你要是不忙，我這裡有份工作。感興趣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
Have you been alone with a woman inside a Jeepney? Wow that was awkward...  I'm never going to get married at this rate...
Oh yes, there is a job for you if you are not too busy. Are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
你有試過和女生單獨坐在吉普尼裡嗎？尷尬死了......照這樣下去，我怕是永遠娶不到老婆了......
對了，你要是不忙，我這裡有份工作。感興趣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
If you are bored, how about you stand guard for me? This is a heck of a job. You have to keep standing like a statue even till the sun rises up above your head.
Oh yes, there is a job for you if you are not too busy. Are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
要是你閒著沒事，不如替我站會兒崗？這活兒可不輕鬆，得像雕像一樣站著，直到太陽昇到頭頂。
對了，你要是不忙，我這裡有份工作。感興趣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
The one who contributed the most in the Jejeling hunt was {0}.
Oh yes, there is a job for you if you are not too busy. Are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
食人波利討伐中，出力最多的人是{0}。
對了，你要是不忙，我這裡有份工作。感興趣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
Yesterday, I saw someone who was carried off to the hospital after rolling down the stairs at the park. That person went by the name of {0}. I wonder if that person is alright.
Oh yes, there is a job for you if you are not too busy. Are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
昨天有人在公園的樓梯上摔下來，被送去醫院了。那人叫{0}，不知道現在怎麼樣了。
對了，你要是不忙，我這裡有份工作。感興趣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
Recently, there have been a few that gained recognition for their bravery among the villagers.{0}, {1}, {2}... Isn't that amazing?
Oh yes, there is a job for you if you are not too busy. Are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
最近有幾位村民因為勇敢而受到大家稱讚。{0}、{1}、{2}......真了不起，對吧？
對了，你要是不忙，我這裡有份工作。感興趣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
We are going to organize an extensive Jejeling hunt this time.
Peddlers going in and out of Baryo are always complaining about Jejelings.
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
這次我們要大規模討伐食人波利。
巴里奧一帶進出的商販總在抱怨它們。

scripts.text: Join the Jejeling hunt.
scripts.translation: 參加食人波利討伐

scripts.text: Refuse.
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
Is that so? I'm sorry to hear that.
Things would be so much simpler if we had a person like you around.
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
這樣啊，真遺憾。
要是有你這樣的人幫忙，事情就輕鬆多了。

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
You just have to hunt 20 jejelings each.
It would be a simple task for you.
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
你只要殺掉20只食人波利就行。
對你來說應該不難。

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
You have to get rid of 20 Jejelings.
20 should be enough to give those Jejelings a good scare.
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
請消滅20只食人波利。
讓它們吃點苦頭，20只應該就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
Oh, the hunt is over, but you haven't killed all the Jejelings.
Come again if you want another try.
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
討伐活動結束了，不過你還沒殺夠食人波利。
想再試一次的話，歡迎回來。

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
Oh, I have confirmed you got rid of 20 Jejelings.
Here, this is a reward for people who participated in the Jejeling hunt.
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
很好，你已經消滅了20只食人波利。
這是給參加討伐的人的獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
I think there will be more Jejeling hunts in the future. Please join us again next time.
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
以後應該還會舉辦食人波利討伐，下次也請來幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Rodel the Guard]
Please understand even if people look at you warily.
The ghost have been haunting the people around here.
scripts.translation:
[守衛羅德爾]
即使村民對你有所戒備，也請多包涵。
附近一直有幽靈出沒，騷擾大家。

scripts.text: - Cannot proceed with the quest. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 物品欄已滿，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Looks like this soul came across a big body of water.
Young friend.
The reason you found me... yes... I see.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
看來這個靈魂渡過了一大片水域。
年輕的朋友，你來找我......嗯，我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
You don't have to say it in words.
The people are overly cautious of you.
Rodel was probably concerned about it, so he sent you here.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
不用開口解釋。
村民們對你格外謹慎，羅德爾大概擔心這一點，所以才讓你來找我。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
No?
Well then maybe there was some kind of a Spiritual bond between us.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
不是嗎？
那也許是我們之間有某種靈性上的牽繫。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Nonetheless, good to meet you, young friend.
Don't blame the villagers too much for their attitudes toward you.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
不管怎樣，很高興見到你，年輕的朋友。
村民們對你有所防備，別太怪他們。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
We are always surrounded by spirits.
We live with them, praying for peace.
But recently, there has been a problem.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
我們身邊一直有靈體環繞。
我們與它們共處，祈求彼此安寧。
但最近出了些問題。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
For some unknown reason,
Spirits have been running amok, and evil sprits have been haunting the villagers.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
不知為何，靈體們開始躁動，邪靈還不斷騷擾村民。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
This is the shadow that is cast on this beautiful town.
They are cautious because they don't know when the dark shadow will fall on them.
They visit without warning.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
這就是籠罩著這座美麗城鎮的陰影。
人們不知道黑暗何時會降臨，所以總是提心吊膽。
邪靈出現時毫無預兆。

scripts.text:
^4d4dffPhong in Mumbaki turns his head and dark shadows appear.
People are in panic, everyone trembling with fear.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff蒙巴基的豐轉過身，黑影隨之浮現。
人們陷入恐慌，個個嚇得瑟瑟發抖。^000000

scripts.text: Step toward the shadow.
scripts.translation: 走向黑影

scripts.text: Draw weapon.
scripts.translation: 拔出武器

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
They have followed the trace of the outsider. 
Don't get to close too them.
Your soul can get absorbed.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
它們循著外來者的氣息追來了。
別靠得太近，你的靈魂可能會被吞噬。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Hmm? They are responding.
I don't understand? They look scared as if facing a powerful soul.
This feeling... it can't be...
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
嗯？它們有反應了。
真奇怪......它們看起來很害怕，像是遇見了強大的靈魂。
這種感覺......難道是......

scripts.text:
^4d4dffLike words of Phong in Mumbaki, spirits are responding to something, hesitating.
Observing their reaction, you get closer. The spirits are flustered.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff正如蒙巴基的豐所說，靈體們似乎感應到了什麼，猶豫不前。
你觀察著它們的反應，慢慢靠近，靈體們頓時慌亂起來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Amazing. Holder of a soul so strong and pure...!
The dark spirits have disappeared because of your presence.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
太不可思議了！你的靈魂竟如此強大而純淨......！
黑暗靈體因為你的到來而消散了。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
I think other villagers would treat you differently now...
Haven't we all witnessed this miracle?
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
我想村民們以後會對你另眼相看......
大家都親眼見證了這場奇蹟，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Young friend. Your presence is welcomed anywhere.
The light from your pure soul will protect you from the darkness.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
年輕的朋友，無論走到哪裡，大家都會歡迎你。
純淨靈魂的光芒會護你抵擋黑暗。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Everyone in the village witnessed how strong and pure your soul is.
Do not be afraid of the dark.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
村裡所有人都見識過你靈魂的強大與純淨。
不必害怕黑暗。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Is there something wrong?
You look disturbed.
Your clothes also look messed up. Was there some kind of trouble?
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
怎麼了？你看起來有些不安，衣服也亂了。遇到什麼麻煩了嗎？

scripts.text: Explain what happened.
scripts.translation: 告訴他發生了什麼。

scripts.text: There is nothing to talk about.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼可說的。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Is that so?
Ha ha... that is a big problem. 
You must've been concerned.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
是嗎？
哈哈......那可真是件麻煩事，你一定很擔心吧。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
You know, we were preparing a spiritual protection for 
villagers who are afraid of evil spirits...
but preparation is not going well.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
你知道，我們正在準備護符，想保護那些害怕邪靈的村民......
可準備得不太順利。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
As a temporary solution, how about giving them what they want?
Just pick among the items you have that are unimportant and give them to them.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
要不先用個權宜之計，把他們想要的東西送給他們？
從你身上挑些不重要的物品分給大家就行。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
All they want is inner peace anyways.
They give meaning to little things and find peace within that behavior.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
他們想要的其實只是心安。
他們會把小東西視作護身符，從中獲得安心。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
What is really important is the belief that you will be safe as long as you carry that item.
If people can stop being afraid by holding on to your old shirt button, then that button is a Spiritual Protection.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
重要的是相信帶著那樣東西就能平安無事。
如果一顆舊襯衫紐扣能讓人不再害怕，那它就是護身符。

scripts.text:
^4d4dffAs Mumbaki said, giving out some items to serve as a Spiritual Protection would be a good idea.
What would be adequate as a Spiritual Protection..^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff正如蒙巴基的豐所說，分發一些物品充當護身符，或許是個好主意。
什麼東西適合做護身符呢......^000000

scripts.text: Holy Water!
scripts.translation: 聖水！

scripts.text: Holy magical item Blue Gemstone?!
scripts.translation: 神聖的魔法物品——藍色魔力礦石？

scripts.text: Writing utensils or school supplies
scripts.translation: 書寫工具或文具

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
The name itself suggests holiness.
It was blessed by the Holy Water, yes?
Not bad.
Is there another? Something more persuading would be nice.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
光聽名字就覺得神聖。
這是用聖水祝福過的，對吧？
不錯。
還有別的嗎？要是有更能說服人的東西就好了。

scripts.text: Talk about Blue Gemstone.
scripts.translation: 談談藍色魔力礦石。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Aha... a stone that disappears after absorbing the curse or magical affect instead of the holder.
Used in holy magic?
Sounds good.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
啊哈......這是一種石頭，能替持有者吸收詛咒或魔法效果，然後自身消失。
用於神聖魔法？聽起來不錯。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Aha... a stone that disappears after absorbing the curse or magical affect instead of the holder.
Used in holy magic?
But it does not sound so holy though.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
啊哈......這是一種石頭，能替持有者吸收詛咒或魔法效果，然後自身消失。
用於神聖魔法？不過聽起來不夠神聖。

scripts.text: Talk about the Holy Water.
scripts.translation: 談談聖水。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
The name itself suggests holiness.
It was blessed by the Holy Water, yes?
Sounds good.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
光聽名字就覺得神聖。
這是用聖水祝福過的，對吧？
聽起來不錯。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Hmm? It isn't too bad if you are always going to carry it around.
But I think something that looks more persuading would be better.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
嗯，要是能一直帶在身上，倒也不錯。
不過我覺得最好找個看起來更有說服力的東西。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
It would be better is there is a holy feel to it...
Do you have something that was blessed by your god?
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
最好能帶點神聖的氣息......
你有受過神明祝福的物品嗎？

scripts.text: Holy Water or Blue Gemstone?
scripts.translation: 聖水還是藍色魔力礦石？

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
The name itself suggests holiness.
It was blessed by the Holy Water, yes?
Stone that protects the bearer...
Sounds perfect.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
光聽名字就覺得神聖。
這是用聖水祝福過的，對吧？
能保護持有者的石頭......聽起來再合適不過了。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Can you find Holy Water and Blue Gemstone that you spoke of?
While I'm working on the Spiritual Protection, you can give out the Holy Artifacts.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
你能找來剛才說的聖水和藍色魔力礦石嗎？
我會製作護符，你則把這些聖物分發給村民。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
People's trust toward you will grow stronger if you do that.
They will trust and listen to you.
Yes, because you will become their heart's savior.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
這樣一來，大家就會更加信任你，也更願意聽你說話。
你會成為他們心中的救世主。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffListening to Phong in Mumbaki, you decided to give out Holy Water and Blue Gemstone to the villagers.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff聽了蒙巴基的豐的話，你決定把聖水和藍色魔力礦石分發給村民。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Is that so?
Tell me if anything happens.
For you, it'll be my pleasure to lend you a hand
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
是嗎？有任何情況都告訴我。
我很樂意幫你。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Holy Water and Blue Gemstone you spoke of will function well. 
I hope they can set aside their fear and worries this way...
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
你提到的聖水和藍色魔力礦石應該很合適。
希望它們能讓大家放下恐懼與不安......

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Did you give out your present to everyone?
By doing this, you made friends with everyone in the town.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
禮物都分發出去了嗎？
這麼一來，你就和鎮上的人們都熟絡起來了。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
I found ways to build Spiritual Protection.
My grandchild Imelda will create it.
So don't worry. You don't have to give out any more of your things.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
我已經想到製作護符的方法了。
我孫女伊梅爾達會負責製作。
放心，你不用再拿自己的東西出來分發了。

scripts.text: [Phong in Mumbaki]
scripts.translation: [蒙巴基的豐]

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
I don't know if you are aware of this, but {0} even aided Baryo. I feel good to know that there is a one more good soul around.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
你可能還不知道，{0}甚至幫過巴里奧。知道世上又多了一個善良的人，我很高興。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Welcome! Welcome! You are always welcome around here.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
歡迎！歡迎！這裡隨時歡迎你。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
I witnessed a traveler who flipped backward after stepping on a fruit peel. {0}. He cried out 'Ouch! Somebody please help~'. We all had a good laugh.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
我看見一位旅行者踩到果皮，整個人向後摔倒。{0}。他大喊：“哎喲！誰來幫幫我～”大家都笑成一團。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
I have never in my life living as a Mumbaki seen a soul as pure and as strong as that of {0}'s. Yes, even stronger and purer than yours.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
我這一生從未見過比{0}更純淨、更強大的靈魂。沒錯，甚至比你的靈魂還要強大純淨。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
There is a traveler recently that has been gaining popularity in the village. The traveler's name was {0}. Outsiders seem to be very vigorous.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
最近村裡有位旅行者很受歡迎，名叫{0}。外來者似乎都很有活力。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
There was a traveler who is as brave as you. The traveler went by the name of {0}. Do you know that person?
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
以前有位勇敢的旅行者和你一樣，名叫{0}。你認識他嗎？

scripts.text: Ask for advice.
scripts.translation: 請教一下。

scripts.text: Bless flowers...
scripts.translation: 祝福花朵......

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Ferry at the Port?
So that has happened...
Important thing is to first find out why that child is so upset.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
港口的渡船？
竟然發生了這種事......
眼下最重要的是弄清那個孩子為何如此難過。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
In this case, a bribe would work perfectly.
Flowers are always the best choice for seducing woman, right?
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
這種時候，送點禮物正合適。
鮮花最能打動女孩子了，對吧？

scripts.text: This is not a love consulting.
scripts.translation: 這又不是戀愛諮詢。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
I'm just saying.
Dead or alive, that poor soul is just a little girl.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
我只是提個建議。
不管是生者還是死者，那可憐的靈魂終究只是個小女孩。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Girls that age will smile even at the falling leaves.
Open her heart with an armful of flowers.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
那個年紀的女孩，看到落葉都會開心。
捧上一束花，或許就能讓她敞開心扉。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Let's see...
^4d4dff3 Mystic Flowers, 3 Elegant Flowers, 3 Pretty Flowers^000000 would be enough to make a Bouquet.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
讓我算算......
^4d4dff神秘之花、優雅之花、美麗之花各3朵^000000，應該就能紮成一束花。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Gather these flowers, and I'll make a Bouquet out of it and bless it.
Flowers can be found out side the village.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
把這些花收集來，我會把它們紮成花束並加以祝福。
村外就能找到這些花。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
There are ^4d4dff3 Mystic Flowers, 3 Elegant Flowers, 3 Pretty Flowers^000000.
Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
要^4d4dff神秘之花、優雅之花、美麗之花各3朵^000000。明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Oh... I can smell the scent of flowers from here.
I'll gather these and bless them.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
哦......我在這裡都聞到花香了。
我來把它們收好，再為花束祝福。

scripts.text:
-Phong in Mumbaki carries out a blessing ceremony after carefully tying flowers into a Bouquet.-
-Just by watching it, holiness overwhelms you.-
scripts.translation:
- 蒙巴基的豐仔細紮好花束，隨後舉行了祝福儀式。 -
- 僅僅看著它，神聖的氣息便撲面而來。 -

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Isn't it a beauty?
Not bad for a old man huh?
I made so many Offering Bouquets in the past that I can make one with my eyes closed now.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
很美吧？我這把年紀，手藝還不錯吧？
以前我做過許多供奉花束，現在閉著眼睛都能扎出來。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Now, deliver this to that child.
I hope she opens her heart with this and becomes willing to talk to you.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
現在把這束花送給那個孩子吧。
希望她能因此敞開心扉，願意和你交談。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Take this Bouquet and talk to the spirit that has nested in the boat.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
拿著這束花，去和棲身在船上的靈體談談吧。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
It is a pity to see a misfortunate spirit... just as with that Ferry incident.
If you are going to offer a Bouquet for a spirit, I'm always willing to help.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
看到不幸的靈體真讓人惋惜......就像那次渡船事件一樣。
如果你想為靈體獻花，我隨時樂意幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
There is nothing this old man can tell you.
Nothing can beat staying healthy, right?
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
我這老頭子也沒什麼好建議。
身體健康才是最重要的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Who is the floral tribute for?
Don't tell me you're making one in advance cause you're lazy?
A tribute must be sincere. Don't forget that.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
這束花是要獻給誰的？
別告訴我你是懶得臨時準備，才提前做好的？
供奉必須出於誠心，別忘了。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Isn't it already made?
What is that in your hand?
Why are you standing around here? Go and give out those flowers.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
不是已經做好了嗎？
你手裡拿的是什麼？
還站在這裡做什麼？快把花送出去吧。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Going to Diwata?
You need Mysterious Flowers, Elegant Flowers and Beautiful Flowers, 3 of each, okay?
I'll make it when the flowers are ready.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
要去找迪瓦塔嗎？
記住，神秘之花、優雅之花和美麗之花各要3朵。
花收齊了我就幫你扎花束。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Diwata is some woman.
And you going to her every day is something too.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
迪瓦塔是個女人啊。
而你天天去找她，也挺有意思的。

scripts.text:
[Phong in Mumbaki]
Hey, here's the Bouquet.
Make offerings with your soul and wish for a fruitful day.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的豐]
來，花束給你。帶著誠心獻上它，祈願今天諸事順遂。

scripts.text: - Cannot proceed with the quest. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 物品欄已滿，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
.... Hmm.

[Imelda]
..........
Not bad.
I have my eyes on you. Let's see how you do in this town.. *chuckle*
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
............不錯。
我會留意你的表現。看看你在這座鎮上能做到什麼程度......*輕笑*

scripts.text: - She is a rather annoying little girl. -
scripts.translation: - 真是個有點煩人的小女孩。 -

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Aren't you the hero who recently got on the villagers good side with the cheap foreign Holy Artifact?
What's up?
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
你就是最近拿廉價外來聖物討好村民的那個英雄？找我有什麼事？

scripts.text: You want to make a traditional Spiritual Protection?
scripts.translation: 你想製作傳統護符嗎？

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Yes. My grandfather found a way.
I'm going to make it.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
沒錯，祖父已經找到製作方法了，我會親手做。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
This is my job and nobody else's.
Protecting traditions is my job.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
這是我的工作，誰也不能代替。守護傳統就是我的職責。

scripts.text: Is that so?
scripts.translation: 這樣啊？

scripts.text: Good luck on your own!
scripts.translation: 那就祝你自己順利咯！

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Of course.
And to get help from someone as... weak as you is not such a good idea.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
當然。不過向你這種......這麼弱的人求助，可不是什麼好主意。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Getting the materials is not as easy as it sounds.
Maybe when you become stronger, yes, but not now. Never.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
收集材料沒你想的那麼簡單。
也許等你變強後還能幫忙，但現在？想都別想。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
What then?
You're going to get the materials?
Fine I'll accept your proposal.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
所以呢？你打算去收集材料？
好吧，我接受你的提議。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
If you wanted to help me out so much, why didn't you say so from the beginning?
Or ask my grandfather?
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
你既然這麼想幫我，為什麼不早點說？或者去問我祖父啊？

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
If you are so enthusiastic about making a Spiritual Protection.
I'd have to give up, won't I?
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
你這麼積極地想幫忙製作護符，我反倒沒法拒絕了，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Now, the needed materials are ^4d4dff6 Sharpened Bamboos, 6 Salt bags and 6 Silver Crosses^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
需要的材料是^4d4dff6根削尖的竹子、6袋鹽和6個銀十字架^000000。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
You'll have to manufacture the salt yourself at the north western beach.
You'll find the pits I've made there.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
鹽得由你自己到西北海灘去曬。
我在那裡挖了鹽田。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Go to Pandoi at the weapon shop for the Silver Crosses.
He promised to make me some.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
銀十字架去武器店找潘多伊拿，他答應替我做一些。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Sharpened Bamboos you can get at Baryo or from a nearby forest.
You got all that?
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
削尖的竹子可以在巴里奧或附近森林找到。都記住了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Now's the time to prove your prowess!
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
現在正是證明你本事的時候！

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Indeed.
I will protect the village!
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
沒錯，我會保護這個村莊！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now I haven't seen any Spiritual Protections made with those!
Interesting~
I'm sure you'll do just fine~
Ha ha ha ha~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我還沒見過用這些材料做護符呢！真有意思～
我相信你肯定能做好～哈哈哈哈～

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Stop annoying me and go away!
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
別煩我，走開！

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
I'll approve you as worthy if you bring all the materials for the Spiritual Protection!
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
把護符所需的材料全帶來，我就承認你夠格！

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Manufacture the salt at the north western beach and bamboos grow in Baryo Mahiwaga.
Ask Pandoi to make the Silver Crosses.
Don't forget to get 6 of each.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
鹽要到西北海灘去曬，巴里奧·馬希瓦加附近能找到竹子。銀十字架就找潘多伊做。每種都要6個，別忘了。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
... Oh... My, you really did get them?
You're better than I thought.
That was not a compliment at all!
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
......哦，天哪，你真的弄到了？比我想的能幹。
我可不是在誇你！

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Now I'm going through the holy ritual to make a traditional Spiritual Protection.
Give them to me! And don't bother me during the process!
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
現在我要舉行神聖儀式，製作傳統護符。
把材料給我，儀式期間別來打擾！

scripts.text:
Imelda is in ritual with a devout aura, compared to when she streamed invectives.
Better not disturb her.
scripts.translation:
伊梅爾達正神情虔誠地舉行儀式，和先前破口大罵的樣子判若兩人。
還是別打擾她了。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Still here?
Of course, you want to see how much better my Spiritual Protection is compared to that cheap Holy Artifact.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
還沒走？當然，你是想看看我的護符比那些廉價聖物強多少吧。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Fine.
Now go and give these Spiritual Protections to the people!
You have all the rights to do so!
*Giggles*
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
好吧。
把這些護符拿去分發給村民！你有這個資格！
*竊笑*

scripts.text:
Took the Spiritual Protection, despite her ridiculous logic and vigor.
Let's give them to the villagers.
scripts.translation:
雖然她的說辭蠻橫又不講理，我還是收下了護符。
把它們分發給村民吧。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Don't disturb the ritual and go away.
Please wait while I make the Spiritual Protection.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
別打擾儀式，快走開。
等我做好護符再來。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
The ones who gets the Spiritual Protections are on the list.
Go and give them the new Spiritual Protections
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
需要護符的人都列在名單上了。
把新護符送給他們吧。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Such a kind person like yourself  will surely do it, won't you? 
*Smirk*
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
像你這麼善良的人，肯定會幫忙的，對吧？
*壞笑*

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
... You really did what I asked you?
You know what? I give up.
I thought you'd leave after getting something from this town with sweet talk...
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
......你真的照我說的做了？
算了，我認輸。我還以為你哄到些東西就會離開這座鎮子......

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
I apologize for my rude behavior.
....This is something to go with the apology.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
我為之前無禮的態度道歉。
......這個就當是賠禮吧。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
I'd be happy if you could help me, because the Spiritual Protections needs to be made every day.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
如果你願意幫忙，我會很高興。護符每天都得製作。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Hello there.
Did you enjoy the scenery of Malaya?
It's nice to have a chat with friends on a Jeepney.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
你好。
馬拉亞的風景看得開心嗎？和朋友一起坐吉普尼聊天挺愜意的。

scripts.text: I'll help you making Spiritual Protections.
scripts.translation: 我來幫你製作護符。

scripts.text: Love and Spiritual Protection for all.
scripts.translation: 讓愛與護符守護每一個人。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Materials for making a Spiritual Protection are
Salt Bags, Silver Crosses and Sharpened Bamboos, 6 of each.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
製作護符需要鹽袋、銀十字架和削尖的竹子，每種各6個。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Salt form the north western beach, Silver Crosses from Pandoi, and Sharpened Bamboos from near Baryo.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
鹽可以從西北海灘取得，銀十字架找潘多伊，削尖的竹子在巴里奧附近就有。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Yes, you got everything precisely.
Thanks for the help.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
沒錯，東西都準備齊了。謝謝你幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
It'll be nice if you could help again tomorrow.
Here's something for your trouble.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
明天也能來幫忙就好了。這是給你的報酬。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
I appreciate your kindness, but we have enough for today.
I'll ask for you when I need more materials.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
謝謝你的好意，不過今天的材料已經夠了。需要補充時我再找你。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Very good timing.
I ran out of materials for today's Spiritual Protections.
Could you go for them now?
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
來得正好。今天做護符的材料已經用完了，能現在幫我去拿嗎？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 好。

scripts.text: I need some preparations.
scripts.translation: 我還得準備一下。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
As usual then.
6 Salt Bags. Silver Crosses and Sharpened Bamboos, please.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
那就照舊，鹽袋、銀十字架和削尖的竹子各6個。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
.......I see.
I'll be waiting then.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
......知道了。我等你。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
That is great news indeed.
You know what you need for making Spiritual Protections?
Of course, it's not your first time...
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
這訊息真不錯。你還記得做護符需要什麼吧？當然，這也不是你第一次幫忙了......

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
I'll leave you to it then.
6 Salt Bags. Silver Crosses and Sharpened Bamboos, please.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
那就交給你了。鹽袋、銀十字架和削尖的竹子各6個。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Please deliver these new Spiritual Protections to the villagers.
You know them, right?
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
把這些新護符送給村民吧。你認識他們，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
They cannot rely on these Spiritual Protections forever...
It would be much better to have a strong mind such as yours.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
他們不能永遠依賴護符......最好能擁有像你這樣堅強的心。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Strong spirits are full of light.
Those of the dark cannot approach due the blinding light
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
強大的靈體會散發光芒。黑暗中的邪靈無法靠近這耀眼的光。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
I guess that's it for today.
Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
今天就先到這裡吧，非常感謝你。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
The Spiritual Protections given before will still be in effect
It's okay for now.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
之前分發的護符仍然有效，眼下不用擔心。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
I was wondering when you would drop by.
Could you deliver Spiritual Protections to the folks today?
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
我還想著你什麼時候會來呢。今天能幫忙把護符分發給大家嗎？

scripts.text: Of course.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text: Not today.
scripts.translation: 今天不行。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Yes.
Why not take a stroll in Malaya today?
Of course, you'll still encounter ghosts here and there.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
好啊。今天不如去馬拉亞四處走走？當然，路上還是會遇到幽靈。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Thank you very much.
Come back when you've given them all out.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
太感謝你了。都分發完後再回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Thanks for your concern, but I couldn't make any because I ran out of materials.
Shame, is it not?
I do hope there's somebody willing to get them for me.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
謝謝你關心，不過材料用完了，我沒法制作護符。真遺憾啊。
希望有人願意幫我收集材料。

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Are you at peace? I could feel your serenity all the way from here.
You want to spend that extra time for me?
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
你現在心裡平靜嗎？我隔著老遠都能感受到。
願意把多出來的時間花在幫我上嗎？

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Could you give out these Spiritual Protections to the villagers for me?
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
能幫我把這些護符分發給村民嗎？

scripts.text:
[Imelda]
Yes.
Why not take a stroll in Malaya today?
Of course, you'll still encounter ghosts here and there.
scripts.translation:
[伊梅爾達]
好啊，今天不如去馬拉亞四處走走？當然，路上還是會遇到幽靈。

scripts.text: - Cannot proceed with the quest. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 物品欄已滿，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
.......
Not from around here, I see. I have nothing to say.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
......
看起來你不是本地人。我沒什麼好說的。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
How about lending a hand for a poor old man?
I don't care if it's just a sleeve of your shirt, just give me something with your vigor.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
能不能幫幫我這個可憐的老人？
哪怕給我一截袖子也行，只要讓我沾一點你的精氣。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
You know, I've not long to go now...
Help me be at peace along the way.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
我時日無多了......
幫我在餘下的日子裡求個心安吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
Y... You!!
You're the young one with such strong spirit to fend off ghosts of darkness?!
Would it be... Possible to share some of your spirit with me?
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
你......你就是那個能憑強大靈力驅散黑暗幽靈的年輕人？！
能不能分一點靈力給我？

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
I have trouble sleeping because of the mischievous ghosts around town, and my back hurts when it rains.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
鎮上那些調皮的幽靈害得我睡不好，天一下雨，我的背又疼得厲害。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
Please share that miraculous spirit of yours with me.
How about just a button of yours?
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
求你分我一點神奇的靈力吧。
給我一顆紐扣也行？

scripts.text: -The troubled villagers desire your belongings because you fend off the ghosts. -
scripts.translation: - 受幽靈困擾的村民想要你的隨身物品，因為你能驅散它們。 -

scripts.text: -So many have already asked you for this. Perhaps it will be better to speak with Phong in Mumbaki.-
scripts.translation: - 已經有不少人向你提出這個要求了。或許該先去找蒙巴基的豐談談。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He'll rake off all my buttons if I talk to him now.
Must counsel with Mumbaki first!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
現在去找他的話，他肯定會把我所有紐扣都要走。
得先問問蒙巴基的意見！

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
To be honest, I do not believe that this Holy Artifact has any abilities.
It's just for the peace of mind.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
說實話，我不覺得這聖物真有什麼力量，只是讓人心裡踏實罷了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
Nevertheless, I see you differently now
To exclude just because someone's an outsider doesn't seem like a good idea anymore.
I'm sorry I ignored you.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
不過我現在對你改觀了。
不能只因為別人是外來者就排斥他們。之前無視你，真對不起。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffPrepare and give Blue Gemstone and Holy Water. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff準備並交付藍色魔力礦石和聖水。^000000

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
So, changed your mind about sharing your spirit?
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
那麼，你改變主意，願意分一點靈力給我了嗎？

scripts.text: Hand over the prepared items.
scripts.translation: 交出準備好的物品

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
Ahh... Thank you.
Now I can be at peace for some time...
...Peace is always good. Yes.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
啊......謝謝你。
這下我能安心一陣子了......
......能平靜度日總是好的。嗯。

scripts.text: - Gave Holy Water and Blue Gemstone to Old Man Nardo.-
scripts.translation: - 把聖水和藍色魔力礦石交給了老人納爾多。 -

scripts.text:
- Gave Holy Water and Blue Gemstone to Old Man Nardo.-
-With the Old Man as last, enough Holy Artifacts have been given out.-
scripts.translation:
- 把聖水和藍色魔力礦石交給了老人納爾多。 -
- 老人納爾多是最後一位，聖物已經全部分發完畢。 -

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
To be honest, I do not believe that this Holy Artifact has any abilities.
It's just for the peace of mind.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
說實話，我不覺得這聖物真有什麼力量，只是讓人心裡踏實罷了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
When you have the time, could you help me out with something?
I'm fine now... I mean later.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
你有空時能幫我辦件事嗎？
我現在沒事......我是說，晚些時候。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
What is it?
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
I hear that {0} is famous in Baryo. Why don't you try for some fame?
What is it?
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
聽說{0}在巴里奧很有名。你也去闖出點名堂吧？
怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
Ah, you again? Thanks for the help back then.
What is it?
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
啊，是你啊？謝謝你上次幫忙。
怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
Once, I saw a traveler who slipped on a piece of fruit. 'Someone help {0}~' he shouted, which gave me a good laugh.
What is it?
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
有次我看見一位旅行者踩到水果滑倒。他大喊：“誰來幫幫{0}～”可把我逗樂了。
怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
I hear that, between merchants, {0}? The name seems to pop up a lot. He seems to be talented in the business.
What is it?
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
聽說商人們最近常提起{0}。這個名字經常出現，看來他很有生意頭腦。
怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
There are plenty of Spiritual Protection these days. {0} was keen at giving out Spiritual Protections. Is it a tradition where you come from?
What is it?
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
最近護符可真不少。{0}特別熱衷於分發護符。那是你們家鄉的傳統嗎？
怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
Do you know Capre? I hear {0} travelers are helping out Capre... Anyhow...
What is it?
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
你認識卡普雷嗎？聽說有{0}位旅行者在幫卡普雷......總之......
怎麼了？

scripts.text: Speak.
scripts.translation: 聊聊。

scripts.text: Give Spiritual Protection.
scripts.translation: 分發護身符。

scripts.text: The Old Man and the Cast Iron Cauldron
scripts.translation: 老人和鑄鐵鍋

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
Port Malaya is a beautiful city.
The old and new are in perfect harmony.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
馬來港真是座美麗的城市，新舊事物在這裡交融得恰到好處。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
Of course there's the recent problem with ghosts wondering about...
It relieves me that you and other young people are working hard on it.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
當然，最近幽靈四處遊蕩，造成了不少麻煩......
看到你和其他年輕人努力解決問題，我也安心些了。謝謝。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffThere's no Spiritual Protection to give to the Old Man.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff現在沒有護身符可以給老人。^000000

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
Is this a new Spiritual Protection made from traditional methods?
I am grateful that you'd replace mine with a new one.
I am always in your and Imelda's debt.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
這是用傳統方法制作的新護身符嗎？謝謝你願意替換掉我的舊護符。我一直承蒙你和伊梅爾達照顧。

scripts.text: -Delivered the Spiritual Protection to Old Man Nardo.-
scripts.translation: - 把護身符交給了老人納爾多。 -

scripts.text:
-Delivered the Spiritual Protection to Old Man Nardo.-
- With the Old Man as last, all Spiritual Protections have been delivered. Head back to Imelda.-
scripts.translation:
- 把護身符交給了老人納爾多。 -
- 老人納爾多是最後一位，所有護身符都已送達。回去找伊梅爾達吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
What? A new Spiritual Protection?
I'm okay. I still have the one you gave me before.
Could you give me a new one when this one wears out?
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
什麼？新的護身符？我沒事，之前你給我的那個還在用。
等舊護符失效了，再給我新的吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
Hmm... You don't look strong enough to travel to Baryo.
I'm sorry but I can't let you carry the precious Cast Iron Cauldron.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
嗯......你看起來還不夠強，去不了巴里奧。抱歉，這口珍貴的鑄鐵鍋不能交給你。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
You've delivered the Cast Iron Cauldron to Baryo, so that's enough for today.
No matter how strong a cauldron is, even with the toughest cast iron, it only lasts a day.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
你已經把鑄鐵鍋送到巴里奧了，今天就到此為止吧。
不管鍋有多結實，用上最好的鑄鐵，也只能撐一天。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
Help me out again tomorrow if you can.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
明天方便的話再來幫我吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
Hey there!
So, are you well and well fed?
Come back again when you have the time.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
你好啊！最近過得好嗎，吃飽了嗎？
有空再來坐坐。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
It's about the Cast Iron Cauldron, but it can wait for after your current errand.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
是鑄鐵鍋的事，不過可以等你忙完手頭的差事再說。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
Did you deliver the cauldron in one piece?
Kiko in Mumbaki should have given you a Spiritual Protection. Do you have it?
You must have left it somewhere. Go fetch it please.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
鍋完好無損地送到了嗎？
蒙巴基的奇科應該給了你一個護符，你帶著嗎？
你肯定是落在哪裡了，去把它找回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
Good. It's the Spiritual Protection promised by Kiko in Mumbaki in return.
I know Imelda makes them and you bring them every day, but more the Spiritual Protections, the better.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
很好。這是蒙巴基的奇科答應給你的謝禮。
我知道伊梅爾達每天都會製作護符，你也天天送過去，不過護符多多益善。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
Please stop by again.
I always prepare the Cast Iron Cauldron needed at Baryo.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
有空再來一趟。
我會備好巴里奧需要的鑄鐵鍋。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
Go to Kiko in Mumbaki at Baryo Mahiwaga and deliver the Cast Iron Cauldron.
This should help against the Bakonawa troubles.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
去巴里奧·馬希瓦加找蒙巴基的奇科，把這口鑄鐵鍋送過去。
應該能幫他們應付巴庫納瓦的麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
Yes, the Cast Iron Cauldron.
Go to Kiko in Mumbaki at Baryo Mahiwaga and deliver the Cast Iron Cauldron.
I'd like you to do it for me...
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
沒錯，就是鑄鐵鍋。
去巴里奧·馬希瓦加找蒙巴基的奇科，把鍋送過去。
我想請你幫我跑一趟......

scripts.text: Cast Iron Cauldron??
scripts.translation: 鑄鐵鍋？

scripts.text: I'll do it.
scripts.translation: 我來送。

scripts.text: I'm busy right now.
scripts.translation: 我現在很忙。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
It's because of the Bakonawa.
Beat the cauldron and the surprised Bakonawa spits back out the moon.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
因為巴庫納瓦。敲打鑄鐵鍋，就能嚇得它把吞下去的月亮吐出來。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
Baryo Mahiwaga is close to where Bakonawa lives, so they are always prepared for trouble.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
巴里奧·馬希瓦加離巴庫納瓦的棲息地很近，所以當地人總得防備突發狀況。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
Enough Cast Iron Cauldrons must be prepared for beating.
But the forge is better here.
So I deliver them every day.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
他們需要許多鑄鐵鍋來敲打。不過這裡的鑄造技術更好，所以我每天都把鍋送過去。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
This is the Cast Iron Cauldron. They have fine blacksmiths in Malaya.
Deliver this to Kiko in Mumbaki at the nearby town of Baryo Mahiwaga.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
這就是鑄鐵鍋。馬來港的鐵匠手藝不錯。
把它送到附近巴里奧·馬希瓦加的蒙巴基奇科那裡。

scripts.text:
[Old Man Nardo]
Is that so.
I'm sorry, you must be very busy.
scripts.translation:
[納爾多老人]
這樣啊。抱歉，你一定很忙。

scripts.text:
[Romel]
.........
 
(He evades your gaze and ignores you.)
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
......
（他避開你的目光，沒有理會你。）

scripts.text:
[Romel]
....So cold-hearted.
And here we are, always trembling in anxiety...
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
......真冷漠。
我們這些人卻一直提心吊膽......

scripts.text:
[Romel]
Not even allowed the peace of mind...
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
連片刻安心都不讓人有......

scripts.text:
[Romel]
Ahh....
... You..
I'm sorry I ignored you.
But... you must be the one they're talking about...
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
啊......
......是你啊。
之前無視你，抱歉。不過......你就是他們常提起的那個人吧......

scripts.text:
[Romel]
Are you the one who fends off the ghosts?
If it's okay with you, can I have one of your belongings or some hair?
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
你就是那個驅散幽靈的人嗎？
不介意的話，能給我一件隨身物品，或幾根頭髮嗎？

scripts.text:
[Romel]
I want to carry it... Like a charm of sort.
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
我想隨身帶著它......當作護身符什麼的。

scripts.text: -The troubled villagers desire your belongings because you fend off the ghosts. -
scripts.translation: - 受幽靈困擾的村民想要你的隨身物品，因為你能驅散它們。 -

scripts.text: - So many have already asked you for this. Perhaps it will be better to speak with Phong in Mumbaki.-
scripts.translation: - 已經有不少人向你提出這個要求了。或許該先去找蒙巴基的豐談談。 -

scripts.text:
Romel looks in your way with a sad look.
He'll surely take a hair or pull a sleeve if he had his way!
scripts.translation:
羅梅爾滿臉憂傷地看著你。
要是由著他來，他肯定會拔你幾根頭髮，或扯下一截袖子！

scripts.text:
[Romel]
Frankly speaking, it's for the peace of mind.
With it, I could face them with more boldness.
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
說實話，我只是想求個心安。有了它，面對那些東西時我就更有勇氣了。

scripts.text:
[Romel]
I mean, I'm relying on such items,
but I am braver with them.
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
我知道自己是在依賴這些東西，
可帶著它們，我確實勇敢多了。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffPrepare and give Blue Gemstone and Holy Water. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff準備並交付藍色魔力礦石和聖水。^000000

scripts.text:
[Romel]
...What is it?
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
......這是什麼？

scripts.text: Hand him the prepared items
scripts.translation: 把準備好的物品交給他

scripts.text:
[Romel]
Oh... Thank you.
I can feel your spirit.
This will keep me safe.
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
哦......謝謝你。
我能感受到你的靈力。
有它在，我就安全了。

scripts.text:
[Romel]
Hey... Could you give some for my daughter as well?
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
那個......能不能也給我女兒一些？

scripts.text: - Gave Romel the prepared Holy Water and Blue Gemstone.-
scripts.translation: - 把準備好的聖水和藍色魔力礦石交給了羅梅爾。 -

scripts.text:
- Gave Romel the prepared Holy Water and Blue Gemstone.-
-With Romel as last, I think enough Holy Artifacts have been given.-
scripts.translation:
- 把準備好的聖水和藍色魔力礦石交給了羅梅爾。 -
- 羅梅爾是最後一位，聖物應該已經分發夠了。 -

scripts.text:
[Romel]
The Holy Artifact is in good hands.
Same with my daughter.
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
有你保管聖物，我就放心了。
我女兒也一樣。

scripts.text:
[Romel]
Hello there.
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Romel]
Hello there.
Merchant Woeon says 'Our {0} sir/ma'am' 'we {1} sir/ma'am' during drinking. I wonder what happened between the two of them?
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
商人沃恩喝醉時總唸叨“我們的{0}大人”“我們{1}大人”。他們倆之間到底發生過什麼？

scripts.text:
[Romel]
Hello there.
Without the slightest doubt, the most famous person in town is {0}. Even famous in Baryo they say.
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
鎮上最有名的人當然是{0}。聽說在巴里奧也很有名。

scripts.text:
[Romel]
Hello there.
The people of the neighboring Baryo Mahiwaga are so strong. Even their children play in the forest. I can't imagine myself doing that.
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
隔壁巴里奧·馬希瓦加的人真強壯，連孩子都敢在森林裡玩。我可不敢那樣。

scripts.text:
[Romel]
Hello there.
It's all thanks to {0} for changing the atmosphere of the house. It seems like we were saved by the Holy Artifact and Spiritual Protection.
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
你好。多虧了{0}，家裡的氣氛都變好了。看來我們是靠聖物和護符得到庇護的。

scripts.text:
[Romel]
Hello there.
Sometimes, my wife makes these sounds in her sleep. {0}... {1}... she says. Who is it? Do you know?! Is she possessed by a ghost?
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
你好。有時我妻子睡覺會說夢話，念著“{0}......{1}......”。她說的是誰？你知道嗎？她是不是被幽靈附身了？！

scripts.text:
[Romel]
Hello there.
Ha ha, I had a dream last night, you see, and there was {0} in the dream. Ha ha... Strange indeed...
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
你好。哈哈，昨晚我做了個夢，夢裡有{0}。哈哈......真奇怪......

scripts.text: Give Spiritual Protection
scripts.translation: 分發護身符

scripts.text: How are things?
scripts.translation: 近來怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Romel]
I am at peace these days.
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
最近我過得很安寧。

scripts.text:
[Romel]
A new Spiritual Protection?
The one you gave me before still works fine.
I'm okay for now.
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
新的護身符？你之前給我的那個還很好用，我暫時不需要。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffThere are no Spiritual Protections to give to Romel.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff現在沒有護身符可以給羅梅爾。^000000

scripts.text:
[Romel]
A new Spiritual Protection.
I was thinking this one had worn out... Thanks for coming.
This Spiritual Protection will also protect us.
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
新的護身符啊。我還以為之前那個已經失效了......謝謝你特地送來。
這枚護符也會保護我們。

scripts.text: - Delivered Romel his Spiritual Protection.-
scripts.translation: - 把護身符交給了羅梅爾。 -

scripts.text:
- Delivered Romel his Spiritual Protection.-
- With Romel as last, all Spiritual Protections have been delivered. Head back to Imelda.-
scripts.translation:
- 把護身符交給了羅梅爾。 -
- 羅梅爾是最後一位，所有護身符都送完了。回去找伊梅爾達吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Talah]
..........gasp!
 
(When your eyes met with hers, she ran and hid behind her father.)
scripts.translation:
[塔拉]
......喘......！
（她一和你對上視線，就跑到父親身後躲了起來。）

scripts.text:
[Talah]
Talah might be taken away tonight.
Scary kids might come to Talah.
scripts.translation:
[塔拉]
塔拉今晚可能會被抓走。
可怕的小孩可能會來找塔拉。

scripts.text:
When Talah tugs at Romel's shirt, Romel looks at you with a sad gaze.
Better do something before they take a button from you...
scripts.translation:
塔拉拽著羅梅爾的衣角，羅梅爾便用哀傷的眼神望向你。
趁他們還沒扯走你的紐扣，最好先想想辦法......

scripts.text:
[Romel]
Hey, could you give my daughter a button or some hair of yours?
She has trouble sleeping at night .......
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
嘿，能給我女兒一顆紐扣或幾根頭髮嗎？她晚上總是睡不好......

scripts.text:
[Romel]
Wouldn't she be able to sleep well if she had something from you as a lucky charm?
scripts.translation:
[羅梅爾]
如果她能把你的東西當護身符帶著，是不是就能睡個好覺了？

scripts.text: - The troubled villagers desire your belongings because you fend off the ghosts. -
scripts.translation: - 受幽靈困擾的村民想要你的隨身物品，因為你能驅散它們。 -

scripts.text: - So many have already asked you for this. Perhaps it will be better to speak with Phong in Mumbaki. -
scripts.translation: - 已經有不少人向你提出這個要求了。或許該先去找蒙巴基的豐談談。 -

scripts.text: Talah looks from you to her father with inquisitive eyes.
scripts.translation: 塔拉好奇地看看你，又看看她父親。

scripts.text:
[Talah]
I dont know for sure
but I get a warm feel from them.
Daddy's braver now and that makes Talah stronger too.
scripts.translation:
[塔拉]
我也說不清......
不過它們讓我覺得很溫暖。
爸爸現在勇敢多了，塔拉也跟著變堅強了。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffPrepare and give Blue Gemstone and Holy Water. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff準備並交付藍色魔力礦石和聖水。^000000

scripts.text:
[Talah]
.... Can I say hello?
Hello... there...
Give the prepared items.
scripts.translation: 交出準備好的物品

scripts.text:
[Talah]
Pretty blue stones...!
Oooooh~ They're beautiful!
Is this stone going to keep Talah safe?
scripts.translation:
[塔拉]
好漂亮的藍色石頭......！
哇～真美！
有了它，塔拉就會安全嗎？

scripts.text: - Delivered the Holy Water and Blue Gemstone to Talah. -
scripts.translation: - 把聖水和藍色魔力礦石交給了塔拉。 -

scripts.text:
- Delivered the Holy Water and Blue Gemstone to Talah. -
-With Talah as last, I think enough Holy Artifacts have been given.-
scripts.translation:
- 把聖水和藍色魔力礦石交給了塔拉。 -
- 塔拉是最後一位，聖物應該已經分發夠了。 -

scripts.text:
[Talah]
Daddy told me to hold on to the Holy Artifact really tight.
So it keeps away bad ghosts...
scripts.translation:
[塔拉]
爸爸讓我把聖物緊緊握在手裡。
這樣壞幽靈就不會靠近了......

scripts.text:
[Talah]
Hello...
Give Spiritual Protection.
scripts.translation: 分發護身符

scripts.text: Hi there?
scripts.translation: 你好呀？

scripts.text:
[Talah]
...Hey...Thank you.
You're keeping us safe aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[塔拉]
......嗨......謝謝你。
你會保護我們，對吧？

scripts.text: ^4d4dffThere is no Spiritual Protection to give to Talah.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff現在沒有護身符可以給塔拉。^000000

scripts.text:
[Talah]
Is this a new Spiritual Protection?
Thank you.
Talah can sleep well now with the Spiritual Protection.
Daddy likes it too.
scripts.translation:
[塔拉]
這是新的護身符嗎？謝謝你。
有它在，塔拉就能睡個好覺了。
爸爸也很喜歡。

scripts.text: - Delivered new Spiritual Protection to Talah.-
scripts.translation: - 把新的護身符交給了塔拉。 -

scripts.text:
- Delivered new Spiritual Protection to Talah.-
- With Talah as last, all Spiritual Protections have been delivered. Head back to Imelda. -
scripts.translation:
- 把新的護身符交給了塔拉。 -
- 塔拉是最後一位，所有護身符都送完了。回去找伊梅爾達吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Talah]
Umm...
The one you gave before still keeps Talah safe.
I'm okay.
scripts.translation:
[塔拉]
嗯......
你之前給的護身符還在保護塔拉。
我沒事。

scripts.text: - Cannot proceed with the quest. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 物品欄已滿，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text: A device to evaporate sea water is buried in the sand...
scripts.translation: 沙裡埋著一個蒸發海水的裝置......

scripts.text: There's enough salt.
scripts.translation: 鹽已經夠了。

scripts.text: A device to evaporate sea water is installed in the Sand Trap.
scripts.translation: 沙坑裡已經裝好了海水蒸發裝置。

scripts.text:
Salt can be scraped off the dried leaves
someone scattered on the sea water.
scripts.translation:
有人把葉子撒在海水上，
等海水蒸發後就能從葉片上刮下鹽。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This should be enough.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這應該夠了。

scripts.text: - Cannot proceed with the quest. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 物品欄已滿，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text: There's a short and black bamboo tree.
scripts.translation: 有一棵又矮又黑的竹子。

scripts.text: There's enough Sharpened Bamboos...
scripts.translation: 削尖的竹子已經夠了......

scripts.text:
There's bamboo here with black cane and leaves.
If some of it is cut off and sharpened, I think it will suffice for the Sharpened Bamboo Imelda wanted.
scripts.translation:
這裡長著黑色竹竿和葉子的竹子。
砍下一些削尖後，應該就能做成伊梅爾達要的竹子了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I knew I could do this!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我就知道自己能做到！

scripts.text: - Cannot proceed with the quest. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 物品欄已滿，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Urghh... Urgh... I got a headache...
My headache must have been brought to me by you from out of town!
Go away. Shoo, leave!
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
呃......呃......我頭好痛......
一定是你這個外鄉人把頭痛傳給我的！走開，快走！

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Now, look here my friend...
This can all be solved by giving me a button.
It doesn't look so expensive either.
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
喂，朋友......
給我一顆紐扣，這事就好解決了。
看起來也不值幾個錢。

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Aha! You're the one they're all talking about!
I was kinda rude right? Forget about it!
Yes, do forget...
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
啊哈！你就是大家議論的那個人！
我剛才有點失禮吧？算了，忘了吧！
對，忘掉就好......

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
If you're in dire need, I could get you a job around here you know..
.... Could you give me some of your things?
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
你要是急需工作，我倒是知道附近哪裡有......
......能給我些你的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
I heard the rumors about you shooing away the ghosts!
Can't you see my shaking hands from fear of them ghosts?
I'll feel much better if you could just give me a button off your sleeve...
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
我聽說你把幽靈趕走了！
你看不到我怕得手都在發抖嗎？給我一顆袖子上的紐扣，我就安心多了......

scripts.text: - The troubled villagers desire your belongings because you fend off the ghosts. -
scripts.translation: - 受幽靈困擾的村民想要你的隨身物品，因為你能驅散它們。 -

scripts.text: - So many have already asked you for this. Perhaps it will be better to speak with Phong in Mumbaki.-
scripts.translation: - 已經有不少人向你提出這個要求了。或許該先去找蒙巴基的豐談談。 -

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Sigh... Life is so tough these days.
Why did ghosts come along to bother me so.
I wish I had a lucky charm or something...
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
唉......最近日子真難過。
幽靈為什麼要來纏著我？
要是有個護身符什麼的就好了......

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Why won't you give me one of your belongings so I could keep as a charm?
Come on, one sock could save a man's life, you know.
Cold hearted son of a...
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
你為什麼不把隨身物品給我當護身符？
拜託啦，一隻襪子都能救人一命。
你這沒心肝的......

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Hmm. Look at my hands.
Less shaky, eh?
Isn't that so?
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
嗯，看看我的手。
沒抖得那麼厲害了吧？對吧？

scripts.text: ^4d4dffPrepare and give Blue Gemstone and Holy Water. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff準備並交付藍色魔力礦石和聖水。^000000

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Humph! What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
哼！你想幹什麼？

scripts.text: Give the prepared items.
scripts.translation: 交出準備好的物品

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Oh dear... Forget about the thing back there.
You see, I was haunted by another ghost after you left...
No hard feelings..
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
哎呀......剛才的事就忘了吧。
你離開後，又有別的幽靈來纏著我......別往心裡去。

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Is this the source of your spirit?
It feels kinda cool!
Perhaps this will fend off some of them...
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
這是你的靈力來源嗎？摸起來涼涼的！
也許能擋住那些幽靈......

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Anyway, thanks a lot.
I'll call for you first when a job opens up for you.
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
總之，太謝謝你了。有適合你的工作，我一定第一個通知你。

scripts.text: - Gave Woeon the Holy Water and Blue Gemstone.-
scripts.translation: - 把聖水和藍色魔力礦石交給了沃恩。 -

scripts.text:
- Gave Woeon the Holy Water and Blue Gemstone.-
-With Woeon as last, I think enough Holy Artifacts have been given.-
scripts.translation:
- 把聖水和藍色魔力礦石交給了沃恩。 -
- 沃恩是最後一位，聖物應該已經分發夠了。 -

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Now... Let's get back to business.
Thanks to you, I don't see any of those darn ghosts.
Ha ha ha ha ha
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
好了......說回正事。
多虧了你，那些討厭的幽靈都不見了。
哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Oh, hi there!
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
哦，你好！

scripts.text: Give Spiritual Protection.
scripts.translation: 分發護身符

scripts.text: The Dealer and his Collection
scripts.translation: 商人和他的收藏品

scripts.text: ^4d4dffThere is no Spiritual Protection to give to Woeon.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff現在沒有護身符可以給沃恩。^000000

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Phew~ A new Spiritual Protection?
Is it an officially made protective charm? Imelda does some fine work.
I'm thankful to you as well, of course.
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
呼～新的護身符？這是正式製作的護符嗎？伊梅爾達手藝真不錯。
當然，也謝謝你幫忙。

scripts.text: -Delivered Spiritual Protection to Woeon.-
scripts.translation: - 把護身符交給了沃恩。 -

scripts.text:
-Delivered Spiritual Protection to Woeon.-
-With Woeon as last, all Spiritual Protections have been delivered.-
scripts.translation:
- 把護身符交給了沃恩。 -
- 沃恩是最後一位，所有護身符都已送達。 -

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Spiritual Protection?
Mine still works fine.
Very effective indeed.
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
護身符？我這個還好好的，效果確實不錯。

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Yes, I collect various by-products from monsters.
In fact, I'm collecting Jejellopys here...
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
沒錯，我會收集各種魔物或動物的副產品。
其實我正在收集食人波利結晶......

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
It's too much for you.
Things can get pretty ugly around here, you see.
I'll let you have at it once you're stronger, my friend!
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
這活兒現在對你來說太危險了，附近的情況可能會變得很糟。等你再強些，我就交給你辦，朋友！

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Oh, the Jejellopy collecting?
I have enough for today.
Come back again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
哦，收集食人波利結晶的事？今天已經夠了，明天再來。

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Oh, yes yes.
You're going to collect Jejellopy today as well?
I know it's a difficult job... But you do it so well.
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
哦，對，你今天也要去收集食人波利結晶嗎？我知道這活兒不容易......不過你做得真不錯。

scripts.text: I'm too busy today.
scripts.translation: 我今天沒空。

scripts.text: Leave it to me!
scripts.translation: 交給我吧！

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Is that so? So it is then.
Come stop by when you need some work.
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
這樣啊，那好吧。需要工作時再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
As usual, bring me 30 Jejellopys, please.
You can get them from the Jejelings.
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
照舊，請帶來30個食人波利結晶。可以從食人波利身上取得。

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Hmm? I don't think you have enough.
I asked you for 30 Jejellopys. Business is business I'm afraid.
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
嗯？數量不夠吧？我說了要30個食人波利結晶。抱歉，做生意可不能馬虎。

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Oh, you have the requested numbers?
I'll take them from here.
You have no need for them, right?
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
數量夠了？那我收下了。你自己也用不上這些吧？

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
So I have all the Jejellopys...
Come back again!
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
食人波利結晶收齊了。歡迎再來！

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
As you can see, I'm a Collection Dealer.
I trade all kinds of monster or animal by-products.
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
如你所見，我是個副產品商人，收購各種魔物和動物的材料。

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
They're used as materials for manufactured goods.
Of course, the most preferred in Port Malaya is from the monster Jejeling..
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
這些東西可以當作製品的原料。馬來港最受歡迎的，當然是食人波利的副產品......

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Jejellopy can be acquired from the Jejeling.
Can you get me 30 Jejellopys?
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
食人波利身上會掉結晶。能幫我弄30個嗎？

scripts.text: Yeah, sure.
scripts.translation: 好，沒問題。

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 不了。

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Is that so. Such a shame.
Come back when you need some work.
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
這樣啊，真可惜。需要工作的話再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Woeon]
Good, I trust you can do it.
Remember, 30 Jejellopys.
scripts.translation:
[沃恩]
好，我相信你辦得到。記住，要30個食人波利結晶。

scripts.text: - Cannot proceed with the quest. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 物品欄已滿，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
...Gasp!
Go... Go away!

[Pandoi]
Please..
Couldn't you help a guy out here, just for the sake of it?
Do you really think ignoring me is the best option?!
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
求你了......能不能幫幫我？就當積德行善？你真覺得無視我才是最好的選擇嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Now look here.
Please give me just a peek..
It's just a button...
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
聽我說。讓我瞧一眼就好......只是顆紐扣......

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Hello there!
I've heard of your prestige.
I was wondering if I could receive something to prove that I've met you in person...
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
你好！久仰你的威名。能不能給我一樣東西，證明我親眼見過你？

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Oh... You're surprised because I'm suddenly so nice to you.
I heard the news you fought off the ghosts.
That's brilliant!
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
哦......我剛才突然這麼友善，你一定很意外吧。我聽說你擊退了幽靈，真了不起！

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
With an item of your spirit, it would scare away the ghosts, wouldn't it?
Please, be generous, I beg you...
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
要是有件帶著你靈力的物品，應該就能嚇跑幽靈了吧？拜託了......求你行行好。

scripts.text: -The troubled villagers desire your belongings because you fend off the ghosts. -
scripts.translation: - 受幽靈困擾的村民想要你的隨身物品，因為你能驅散它們。 -

scripts.text: - So many have already asked you for this. Perhaps it will be better to speak with Phong in Mumbaki.-
scripts.translation: - 已經有不少人向你提出這個要求了。或許該先去找蒙巴基的豐談談。 -

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Phew... Life is so tough these days.
Why did ghosts come along to bother me so.
I wish I had a lucky charm or something...
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
唉......最近日子真難過。幽靈為什麼總來煩我？
要是有個護身符什麼的就好了......

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Please...
Couldn't you help a guy out here, just for the sake of it?
Do you really think ignoring me is the best option?!
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
求你了......能不能幫幫我？就當積德行善？你真覺得無視我才是最好的選擇嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Now that I have confidence, the only thing left for me to do is charge to the hospital or field for material!
Bu... But, I'm too scared...
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
現在我有信心了，只差親自去野外或醫院找材料！可......可我還是害怕......

scripts.text: ^4d4dffPrepare and give Blue Gemstone and Holy Water. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff準備並交付藍色魔力礦石和聖水。^000000

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Wh, what, you've finally decided to help me?!
You're going to give Pandoi a gift of peace?!
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
什、什麼？你終於決定幫我了？！要送給潘多伊一份安心嗎？！

scripts.text: Give the prepared items.
scripts.translation: 交出準備好的物品

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Great! I knew you'd come back!
Yes... Now that I have some of your spirit, I can rest well at night.
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
太好了！我就知道你會回來的！
現在有了你的靈力，我晚上總算能睡個好覺。

scripts.text: - Gave Pandoi the Holy Water and Blue Gemstone.-
scripts.translation: - 把聖水和藍色魔力礦石交給了潘多伊。 -

scripts.text:
- Gave Pandoi the Holy Water and Blue Gemstone.-
-With Pandoi as last, I think I've given enough Holy Artifacts.-
scripts.translation:
- 把聖水和藍色魔力礦石交給了潘多伊。 -
- 潘多伊是最後一位，聖物應該已經分發夠了。 -

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Sil... Silver. I need silver, please.
I thought I could get the silver once the ghosts are gone, but I can't...
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
銀......我需要銀，求你了。
我本以為幽靈走了就能去拿銀，可還是不行......

scripts.text: [Pandoi]
scripts.translation: [潘多伊]

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Hello there?!
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
你好啊？！

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
{0}made a huge discovery. A dragon, they say.
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
{0}有了重大發現。聽說是一條龍。

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
As far as I can see, recently, {0} is the most diligent person around. He's like a god of hard work.
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
我看啊，最近{0}是附近最勤奮的人，簡直像勤勞之神。

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
You, {0}, lit up my soul. It sparkles, you know. No? You don't?
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
{0}，你點亮了我的靈魂。它閃閃發光，你知道嗎？不覺得嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
I've seen you, {0} beating those Jejelings outside the town. The energy... I... I was so impressed!
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
{0}，我看見你在城外打那些食人波利了。那股氣勢......我......我太佩服了！

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
You know. {0}. You are my hero for becoming stronger. I look up to you!
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
你知道嗎，{0}？你變強了，簡直就是我的英雄！我很崇拜你！

scripts.text: Give Spiritual Protection.
scripts.translation: 分發護身符

scripts.text: Silver Blade.
scripts.translation: 銀劍

scripts.text: Silver Cross
scripts.translation: 銀十字架

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
I appreciate you taking care of the expiration dates of my Spiritual Protection.
I think mine's good for now. 
When it wear's out, I'll ask you for another one!
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
謝謝你留意我的護身符快過期了。我這個還能用，等它失效了再來給我新的吧！

scripts.text: ^4d4dffThere is no Spiritual Protection to give to Pandoi.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff現在沒有護身符可以給潘多伊。^000000

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Good. A new Spiritual Protection.
It's always good to know that you won't see those black things again!
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
太好了，新的護身符！知道那些黑影不會再出現，真讓人安心。

scripts.text: -Delivered Spiritual Protection to Pandoi.-
scripts.translation: - 把護身符交給了潘多伊。 -

scripts.text:
-Delivered Spiritual Protection to Pandoi.-
-With Pandoi as last, all Spiritual Protections have been delivered.-
scripts.translation:
- 把護身符交給了潘多伊。 -
- 潘多伊是最後一位，所有護身符都已送達。 -

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Hmm... To make a Silver Blade, you need silver.
I could melt Silver Bracelets to get silver.
Silver Bracelets can be acquired at the hospital.
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
嗯......打造銀劍需要銀。我可以熔化銀手鐲提取白銀。
銀手鐲可以去醫院找。

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
However, I don't think you can make it right now. I'm sorry, it's just too much for you!
If you go in there like that... You'll never make it out alive!
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
不過你現在還不夠強，抱歉，這對你來說太難了！就這麼闖進去的話......恐怕有去無回！

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Where are the Silver Bracelets?
I know you're invincible...
But I must have a Silver Bracelet to make a Silver Blade.
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
銀手鐲在哪兒？我知道你很厲害......可打造銀劍還是得有銀手鐲。

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
10 Silver Bracelets!
Regardless of how many of them you hinder, I need 10 Silver Bracelets!!
Now it is in your hands!
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
10個銀手鐲！不管有多少阻礙，我都需要10個！！
現在就看你的了！

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Respect, all the way!
You fought them off and brought the Silver Bracelets as well.
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
太令人敬佩了！你不但擊退了它們，還把銀手鐲帶回來了。

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
From this day on, I shall try to smelt a new silver weapon..!!
I will pound and beat at them until I am left with a fine silver blade in my hands...!!
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
從今天起，我要試著熔煉一把全新的銀製武器！！
我要不停敲打，直到手中鍛出一柄精緻的銀劍！！

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
It's not much, but here's something for the troubles you went through to get the Silver Bracelets.
If I fail... I'll ask of you the task again!
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
雖然不是什麼貴重東西，還是請收下，感謝你辛苦找來銀手鐲。
要是我失敗了......恐怕還得再拜託你一次！

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
The village hospital holds the most hideous things inside.
I'm not sure what exactly... Whatever's in there, I'm not willing to go near it...
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
村裡的醫院裡藏著最可怕的東西。我也不知道具體是什麼......反正我不敢靠近......

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Please get rid of those rumored monsters and get those Silver Bracelets.
You're the only one I can trust!
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
請幫我消滅那些傳聞中的魔物，把銀手鐲帶回來。你是我唯一信得過的人！

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
I still have some silver to smelt.
I'll request more if I fail again.
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
我手頭還有些銀可以拿來熔煉。要是又失敗了，我再拜託你。

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Oh... what am I to do?
I've wasted the precious materials you brought back for me...
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
唉......我該怎麼辦？我把你辛苦帶回來的珍貴材料全浪費了......

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Maybe I'm not supposed to be a blacksmith!
I'm good with crafting silver, though!
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
也許我根本不適合做鐵匠！不過我做銀器倒挺拿手的！

scripts.text: I'll get you the materials. Cheer up.
scripts.translation: 我會幫你找材料，打起精神來。

scripts.text: Give up. It's a lot easier when you do.
scripts.translation: 放棄吧，那樣輕鬆多了。

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
... You're right...
I'll never be able to make a Silver Blade...
Give up... I thought you'd cheer me up.. I'm a little disappointed in you.
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
......你說得對......我永遠也做不出銀劍......
叫我放棄......我還以為你會鼓勵我呢，真有點失望。

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
I knew I could count on you!
I knew I could count on you!
10 Silver Bracelets, please.
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
我就知道你靠得住！真的！
麻煩再帶10個銀手鐲來。

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Pandoi will always smile at you~
*Grin*
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
潘多伊會一直對你笑～
*咧嘴笑*

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Silver Blade!
It's great. Wonderful! The holy blade to carve all evil with one stroke...!
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
銀劍！！太棒了，太完美了！這把神聖之劍能一擊斬盡所有邪惡......！

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
I want to be a noted blacksmith by making a Silver Blade.
However, I cannot get the materials.
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
我想打造一把銀劍，成為有名的鐵匠。
可我弄不到所需的材料。

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
I heard that they wore silver bracelets as recognition at the hospital.
But when I got there, it was not the hospital that I used to know.
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
聽說醫院裡的人會戴銀手鐲作為身份識別。可我到了那兒才發現，那已經不是我熟悉的醫院了。

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Could you slay the horrible creepers and get me the Silver Bracelets?
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
能幫我消滅那些可怕的藤蔓怪，再帶回銀手鐲嗎？

scripts.text: Indeed!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text: No. Way.
scripts.translation: 才不去。

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
... You're right...
I'll never make a Silver Blade...
Such plain expression of disgust. You know what? I hate the idea now.
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
......你說得對......我永遠也做不出銀劍了......
你嫌棄得這麼明顯，我現在也不想做了。

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
I knew it!
Teach those things at the hospital some manners...
And bring back 10 Silver Bracelets, please.
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
我就知道！去教訓教訓醫院裡的那些傢伙......
再幫我帶回10個銀手鐲！

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Pandoi will always smile at you~
*Grin*
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
潘多伊會一直對你笑～
*咧嘴笑*

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
You need Silver Crosses?
Pandoi will make them for you!
Still, I cannot create something out of the blue, so I'll be needing some silver.
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
你需要銀十字架嗎？潘多伊幫你做！
不過我不能憑空變出銀子，所以得先弄些白銀來。

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
I could make one Silver Cross for ^4d4dff2 Silver Bracelets^000000 the monsters hold there...
If you have Silver Bracelets, I could make Silver Crosses with them.
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
醫院裡的魔物身上有銀手鐲，^4d4dff每2個銀手鐲^000000就能做1個銀十字架。
你有銀手鐲的話，我就能幫你打造。

scripts.text: Make 1 Silver Cross
scripts.translation: 製作1個銀十字架

scripts.text: Make 6 Silver Crosses
scripts.translation: 製作6個銀十字架

scripts.text: Input Number
scripts.translation: 輸入數量

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
You need at least {0} Silver Bracelets to make {1} Silver Cross.
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
我至少需要{0}個銀手鐲，才能製作{1}個銀十字架。

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
You need at least {0} Silver Bracelets to make {1} Silver Crosses.
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
我至少需要{0}個銀手鐲，才能製作{1}個銀十字架。

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
You need at least 2 Silver Bracelets to make 1 Silver Cross.
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
製作1個銀十字架至少需要2個銀手鐲。

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
You need at least 12 Silver Bracelets to make 6 Silver Crosses.
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
製作6個銀十字架至少需要12個銀手鐲。

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
How many Silver Crosses do you need?
I can make up to 50 at a time.
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
你要做多少個銀十字架？我一次最多能做50個。

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Don't need Silver Crosses?
Well, I can take a rest then. Ha ha ha ha~
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
不需要銀十字架嗎？那我就歇會兒了。哈哈哈哈～

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
A maximum of 50 at a time!
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
一次最多隻能做50個！

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
To make {0} Silver Cross, I need at least {1} Silver Bracelets.
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
製作{0}個銀十字架，我至少需要{1}個銀手鐲。

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
To make {0} Silver Crosses, I need at least {1} Silver Bracelets.
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
製作{0}個銀十字架，我至少需要{1}個銀手鐲。

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
I'll be here if you need me!
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
需要幫忙的話，我就在這裡！

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
It'll take just a second.
Pandoi can do it in a jiffy!
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
馬上就好，潘多伊一下子就能做好！

scripts.text:
[Pandoi]
Look at this!
Very nice indeed.
I should've been a craftsman, not a blacksmith!
scripts.translation:
[潘多伊]
看看這個！真漂亮。
我應該當個工匠，而不是鐵匠！

scripts.text: - Cannot proceed with the quest. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 物品欄已滿，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Oh... This ship's not in service.
Or rather, it can't set sail. *Snigger*
I'm seeing ghosts. I think it's my time to die.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
哦......這艘船已經停運了。
不如說根本開不了船。*竊笑*
我看到幽靈了，看來我的死期到了。

scripts.text: - Pedro the Sailor seems to have given up, but he can't take his gaze off of me.-
scripts.translation: - 水手佩德羅似乎已經認命了，但目光仍緊盯著你。 -

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Oh, you're th... The one who fends off ghosts at the wave of a hand?!
Could you stay for a bit and hear me out?!
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
哦，你是......那個揮揮手就能驅散幽靈的人？！
能不能留步聽我說幾句？

scripts.text: Sorry.
scripts.translation: 抱歉。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 好啊。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Oh, a solid denial.
You just impaled my last glimpse of hope.
Maybe I wasn't persuasive enough...
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
哦，拒絕得可真乾脆，直接刺穿了我最後一絲希望。
大概是我說得不夠有說服力......

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Straight to the point, this town is a den of ghosts!
Sigh... I've been a sailor for quite a while and went to a lot of places, but this I never experienced before.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
我就直說了，這座鎮子簡直是幽靈窩！
唉，我當水手這麼多年，也去過不少地方，可還真沒見過這種事。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
You see that ship there?
It's a small ferry, but it also stopped service because of these darn ghosts!
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
看到那邊的船了嗎？
那是一艘小渡船，也因為那些該死的幽靈停航了！

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
It looks okay from the outside, but it's full of ghost, I tell ya.
But the way I heard it, they're afraid of you, right?
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
從外面看起來好好的，可裡面全是幽靈，我可沒騙你。
不過聽說它們很怕你，對吧？

scripts.text: Oh no, you too...
scripts.translation: 噢不，你也想要......

scripts.text: Not my buttons!
scripts.translation: 別要我的紐扣！

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
I see many have already asked you for some of your stuff for charms, huh.
Can I budge in that line too?
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
看來已經有不少人找你要東西當護身符了。也讓我排個隊，行嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
I need to have some sincere conversations with that ghost over there.
But the spirit is too strong for me to approach.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
我得和那邊的幽靈好好談談。
可它的靈力太強，我根本靠近不了。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
...........That was a lame story.
And it's not easy to give away your stuff to someone else.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
......這故事講得真夠爛的。再說，把自己的東西送人也不容易。

scripts.text: - Pedro the Sailor seems to have given up, but he can't take his gaze off of me.-
scripts.translation: - 水手佩德羅似乎已經認命了，但目光仍緊盯著你。 -

scripts.text: - So many have already asked you for this. Perhaps it will be better to speak with Phong in Mumbaki. -
scripts.translation: - 已經有不少人向你提出這個要求了。或許該先去找蒙巴基的豐談談。 -

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Sigh...
This is so awkward.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
唉......真尷尬。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Anyway, now that I have what they hate...
Now's the time to charge into my ship...!
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
不過現在我有了它們害怕的東西......
該衝上船去了！

scripts.text: ^4d4dffPrepare and give Blue Gemstone and Holy Water.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff準備並交付藍色魔力礦石和聖水。^000000

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
What? I can sense something refreshing in your hands. What is it?
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
什麼？我感覺你手裡有股清爽的氣息。那是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
You're giving it to me?
Ghosts will hate it?
That's wonderful news!
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
你要把它送給我？幽靈會怕它？
這可是天大的好訊息！

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Pedro, at your service!
After you're finished with the ghosts here, I'll take on my ship to the end of the world!
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
佩德羅隨時聽候差遣！
等你解決這裡的幽靈，我就開船帶你去世界盡頭！

scripts.text: - Gave Pedro the Sailor the Holy Water and Blue Gemstone. -
scripts.translation: - 把聖水和藍色魔力礦石交給了水手佩德羅。 -

scripts.text:
- Gave Pedro the Sailor the Holy Water and Blue Gemstone. -
-With Pedro the Sailor as last, I think I gave enough Holy Artifacts.-
scripts.translation:
- 把聖水和藍色魔力礦石交給了水手佩德羅。 -
- 水手佩德羅是最後一位，聖物應該已經分發夠了。 -

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Anyway, now that I have what they hate...
Now's the time to charge into my ship...!
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
不過現在我有了它們害怕的東西......
該衝上船去了！

scripts.text: -Pedro the Sailor looks determined.-
scripts.translation: - 水手佩德羅看起來下定決心了。 -

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Whoa... Did you see that?
Those black souls just came up and disappeared.
Well, living the dream, eh?
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
哇......你看到了嗎？那些黑色靈體剛冒出來就消失了。
哈哈，這下夢想成真了吧？

scripts.text: Give Spiritual Protection.
scripts.translation: 分發護身符

scripts.text: About the Ferry Ride
scripts.translation: 關於渡船

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
The Spiritual Protection you gave me before works fine.
I'm good for now.
It's still up for the fight!
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
你之前給我的護身符很管用，我現在沒事，隨時能繼續戰鬥！

scripts.text: ^4d4dffThere is no Spiritual Protection to give to Pedro the Sailor.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff現在沒有護身符可以給水手佩德羅。^000000

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
A newly made Spiritual Protection.
Alright. I'll go at them with this one today.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
新做的護身符？好，我今天就帶著它去對付那些幽靈。

scripts.text: -Delivered the Spiritual Protection to Pedro the Sailor.-
scripts.translation: - 把護身符交給了水手佩德羅。 -

scripts.text:
-Delivered the Spiritual Protection to Pedro the Sailor.-
-With Pedro the Sailor as last, all Spiritual Protections have been delivered.-
scripts.translation:
- 把護身符交給了水手佩德羅。 -
- 水手佩德羅是最後一位，所有護身符都已送達。 -

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Hmm... Don't you remember me talking about ghosts?
The Ferry is full of ghosts.
Wait, was it one or many?
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
嗯......你不記得我說過船上有幽靈嗎？渡船上全是幽靈......等等，是一個還是一群？

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Whatever. For you and your current condition, it's out of the question.
Yes. You can't do it. You'll be dragged out in a body bag.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
以你現在的狀況根本不可能。沒錯，你辦不到。你會被人裝進屍袋抬出來。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Now I'm not going to stand here and wait for that to happen. No way.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
我可不會站在這兒等著那種事發生，絕對不會。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
I'm sorry, but didn't I say something about ghosts over there?
It can't set sail because of that.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
抱歉，我不是說過那邊鬧幽靈嗎？所以船才開不了。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
So what's this whole ghost story about?
Hmmm..........
It's a long story...
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
所以關於幽靈到底是怎麼回事？嗯......說來話長......

scripts.text: I'm listening.
scripts.translation: 我聽著呢。

scripts.text: Maybe later.
scripts.translation: 以後再說。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
I knew it.
Though, it's not such a boring story.
After all, it is a ghost story.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
我就知道你想聽。不過這故事也不算無聊，畢竟是個幽靈故事。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
The story goes back to when I first made port here.
It was a nerve racking first time as a liner manager.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
故事要從我第一次到這裡靠岸說起。當時我剛當上渡船管理員，緊張得要命。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
I was ready to disembark when I saw something I simply could not believe.
Black haze was swarming to the port from all over town.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
我正準備下船，突然看見了難以置信的一幕：整座鎮子的黑霧都湧向了港口。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
At first, I thought it was just a very thick smog.
As the days went by, it became clear as to what it was.
It was a swarm of souls.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
起初我以為那只是濃煙，可幾天後才看清真相——那是一大群靈魂。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
A very unpleasant group of souls indeed.
Some were wailing some horrible cries around the Ferry about to set sail...
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
那群靈魂可不友善。有些在即將起航的渡船周圍發出可怕的哀嚎......

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
After that incident, that ship stayed on that spot until this day.
Why? Because they took over the ship! It's haunted!
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
從那次之後，那艘船就一直停在那裡。為什麼？因為幽靈佔據了船！它鬧鬼了！

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
If you don't believe me, see for yourself.
Then you'll believe me.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
你要是不信，就親自去看看。看過就相信我了。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
If you want to know, go and see for yourself and get on it.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
想弄清楚的話，就自己去看看，登上那艘船吧。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Soul of a Little Girl?
What about all them bullying ones?
They came and went?
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
小女孩的靈魂？那其他欺負人的幽靈呢？它們都來過又走了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
I don't understand.
Maybe the Leader Mumbaki will know what to do.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
我也不明白。也許蒙巴基的首領知道該怎麼辦。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Hmm... A floral tribute to soothe the soul....
You want to hear its story after it calms down?
Well... Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
嗯......用鮮花供奉，安撫靈魂......你想等它平靜下來後聽聽它的故事嗎？那就祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
It can't be helped for the Ferry to set sail again.
I can't go near it because of those mean ones.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
要讓渡船重新起航，恐怕沒那麼容易。那些惡靈還在船上，我根本不敢靠近。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Now I'm asking you to do this not because I can't be bothered,
but because I simply can't do it myself.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
我請你幫忙，並不是因為我偷懶，實在是自己做不到。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Did Mumbaki bless the flower?
I hope this works...
I wish you all the luck!!
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
蒙巴基的豐給花祝福了嗎？希望能奏效......祝你好運！！

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
I hope you can negotiate with success!
I'll take care of those rude ones outside the ship the best I can.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
希望你們能談妥！我會盡量處理船外那些無禮的幽靈。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
I see.
Perhaps the Ferry can move again...
Thank you for all you've done for us.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
我明白了。也許渡船終於能重新開動了......謝謝你為我們做的一切。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
I'd better get ready to set sail then.
It's not much, but this is for you.
If we can get back in business, I'll take you to Izlude for just 1000z.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
那我得準備起航了。
這點東西不成敬意，收下吧。
等我們恢復運營，我只收你1000 Zeny，就送你去依斯魯得島。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
If you want to go to Alberta, use the big ship over there.
This little one goes to Izlude.
That will be 1000z.
scripts.translation:
[水手佩德羅]
想去艾爾貝塔的話，就坐那邊的大船。
這艘小船開往依斯魯得島。
船費1000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Use.
scripts.translation: 使用

scripts.text: That's a rip off!
scripts.translation: 這也太貴了！

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
What?!
How much do you pay for the Alberta Liner to get here!?
