scripts.text: Done with conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Buwaya? The merciless creature is back?
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
寶箱巨鱷？那個殘暴的傢伙又回來了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
That's bad news. We are already short-handed by assigning everyone to fight off Bangungot.
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
這可糟了。我們已經人手不足，所有人都派去抵擋噩夢死神般滾勾特了。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
And villagers need to go to the woods to collect fruits and vegetables.
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
而且村民還得去森林裡採集蔬果。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Hmm... will you be able to help Port Malaya?
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
嗯......你願意幫幫馬來港嗎？

scripts.text: Leave it to me!
scripts.translation: 交給我吧！

scripts.text: I'm pretty busy myself.
scripts.translation: 我自己也忙得很。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Really? That's no good. All the lives of the villagers will be at stake if we don't do something. How can a youth like you be so heartless. Are all outsiders like you? Hmph! Can't trust young people these days. Hmph.
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
真的嗎？那可不行。我們要是不採取行動，村民的性命都會受到威脅。你年紀輕輕，怎麼這麼冷漠？外來者都像你這樣嗎？哼！現在的年輕人真不可靠。哼。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
I knew I could count on you.
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
我就知道能指望你。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Good. I will trust you.
I need to know where Buwaya will likely appear in order to secure villagers living area.
Guess Buwayas nest will be the best bet.
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
很好，我相信你。
為了保護村民的住處，我得知道寶箱巨鱷可能會在哪裡出沒。
最好先找到它的巢穴。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
^3131FFShoot a smoke bomb^000000 once you reach the area.
Then we will run to where the smoke bomb was shot.
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
到達那一帶後，^3131FF投擲煙霧彈^000000。
我們會朝煙霧升起的地方趕去。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Then take care and good luck.
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
那就小心行事，祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
^3131FFShoot a smoke bomb^000000 once you reach the area.
Then we will run to where the smoke bomb was shot.
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
到達那一帶後，^3131FF投擲煙霧彈^000000。
我們會朝煙霧升起的地方趕去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's first bring Ed to Totoy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們先把艾德帶回托托伊身邊吧。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
The Guard Leader gave you the location of Buwaya's cave.
This can't be happening.
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
衛隊長把寶箱巨鱷洞穴的位置告訴了你。
這下可麻煩了。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
I'm way out of men to assign to the Buwaya situation but well have to do something with what we got.
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
我手下已經抽不出人手來處理寶箱巨鱷了，不過只能靠現有的人力想辦法。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Here, this is a symbol of our gratitude.
If you would like to help with Buwaya again, please look for me.
Hope you have a great journey.
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
拿著，這是我們的一點謝意。
如果還願意幫忙對付寶箱巨鱷，隨時來找我。
祝你旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Hear Buwaya appeared from the depth of the Forest.
As everyone knows, all our manpower is dispatched to handle Bangungots servants attacking the hospital recently.
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
聽說寶箱巨鱷出現在森林深處。
大家都知道，最近我們的人手全派去應對襲擊醫院的噩夢死神般滾勾特僕從了。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
That is why we have no choice but to ask an outsider to help eliminate Buwaya.
They say Buwaya is a very strong and ugly monster with two heads.
Will you help us defeat Buwaya?
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
所以我們只能請外來者幫忙消滅寶箱巨鱷。
據說它是個強壯又醜陋的雙頭魔物。
你願意幫我們打倒它嗎？

scripts.text: Of course.
scripts.translation: 當然願意。

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 不去。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Buwaya is known to be a very dangerous monster.
There is no shame in rejecting this request.
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
寶箱巨鱷是出了名的危險。
拒絕這個請求也沒什麼可羞愧的。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
This mission will be a dangerous one.
If you want to help get rid of Buwaya, you must be prepared.
Come back once you reach LV 130.
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
這次任務很危險。
想幫忙除掉寶箱巨鱷，就得做好準備。
達到130級後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
According to the legend, Buwaya kidnaps people and puts them in the sack on its back and then eats them later.
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
傳說寶箱巨鱷會綁架人，把他們塞進背上的囊袋裡，之後再吃掉。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Keep this in mind and be cautious at all times.
I recommend asking trustful colleagues for help.
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
記住這點，時刻保持警惕。
我建議你找幾個可靠的同伴一起行動。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
How is it going with the Buwaya situation?
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
寶箱巨鱷的事辦得怎麼樣了？

scripts.text: I give up.
scripts.translation: 我放棄了。

scripts.text: Still fighting.
scripts.translation: 還在戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Keep this in mind and be cautious at all times.
I recommend asking trustful colleagues for help.
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
記住這點，時刻保持警惕。
我建議你找幾個可靠的同伴一起行動。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Buwaya is known to be a very dangerous monster.
There is no shame in rejecting this request.
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
寶箱巨鱷是出了名的危險。
拒絕這個請求也沒什麼可羞愧的。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Can't believe you really got rid of Buwaya!
You aren't just any ordinary youth, aren't you? People of Port Malaya can now sleep at night.
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
真不敢相信你真的除掉了寶箱巨鱷！
你可不是普通的年輕人。現在馬來港的居民終於能睡個安穩覺了。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Good work.
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
幹得好。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
I will not stand down until all of Port Malaya, including Baryo Mahiwaga, is safe from Buwaya. Promise to take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[守衛隊長]
在馬來港和巴里奧·馬希瓦加都擺脫寶箱巨鱷的威脅之前，我絕不會退下。你一定要保重。

scripts.text: Bark bark!!
scripts.translation: 汪汪！！

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Bark bark!!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪汪！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why is a dog here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡怎麼會有隻狗？

scripts.text: Look closely at the dog.
scripts.translation: 仔細看看這隻狗

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 不理它

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Looks like a lost dog.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看起來像只走丟的狗。

scripts.text: - Looked real hard at the dirty dog and noticed an old collar on its neck. -
scripts.translation: - 你仔細打量這隻髒兮兮的狗，發現它脖子上戴著一條舊項圈。 -

scripts.text: - The collar says, 'Forever with Totoy'. -
scripts.translation: - 項圈上寫著：“永遠和托托伊在一起”。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So you are Ed?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原來你就是艾德？

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Bark bark!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪！汪！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You didn't get killed by Buwaya. You lucky little dog. Let's go back to your owner.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你居然沒被寶箱巨鱷吃掉，真是命大。走吧，帶你回主人身邊。

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Bark bark!!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪汪！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, before we go, do you happen to know where Buwaya's nest is?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，出發前問一下，你知道寶箱巨鱷的巢穴在哪兒嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Woof!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪！

scripts.text: - Ed is one smart dog and understood what you asked him. Ed started to bark towards the north. -
scripts.translation: - 艾德真聰明，聽懂了你的問題，開始朝北邊叫。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Buwaya is over there!
Then I should shoot the smoke bomb here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
寶箱巨鱷在那邊！
我應該就在這裡發射煙霧彈。

scripts.text: - You take the smoke bomb out of your inventory and shoot towards the sky. -
scripts.translation: - 你從物品欄取出煙霧彈，朝天空發射。 -

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Job well done!
So Buwaya lives in remote place like this. I will make sure this information goes to the Guard Leader!
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
幹得好！
原來寶箱巨鱷住在這麼偏僻的地方。我會把這條訊息報告給衛隊長！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Should I return Ed to Totoy first and then go see the Guard Leader?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是不是該先把艾德送回托托伊身邊，再去找衛隊長？

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Bark bark!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪汪！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Lets first bring Ed to Totoy and then go back to the Guard Leader.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
先把艾德送回托托伊那裡，再去找衛隊長吧。

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
Story of dragon that lives at a lake~
Story of an old lady
that became a dragon long ago~
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的男人]
湖中惡龍的故事~
還有一位老婦人
很久以前變成惡龍的故事~

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
Waiting for the son that left for a foreign land,
my son will return
when that moon sets for the 90th time
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的男人]
等待遠赴異鄉的兒子，
等月亮落下第九十次，
兒子就會回來

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
The moon sets for the 89th,
The moon sets for the 90th,
The moon sets for the 191st...
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的男人]
月亮落下了第八十九次，
月亮落下了第九十次，
月亮落下了第一百九十一次......

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
That moon has taken my son away~
That horrible thing
has swallowed my son,
and I will punish that moon~
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的男人]
那輪月亮奪走了我的兒子~
那可怕的東西
吞掉了我的兒子，
我要懲罰那輪月亮~

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
The day the furious moon hides itself from sight,
the whole world will be flooded with rain
with all the villages and people facing death under water~
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的男人]
憤怒的月亮隱去的那天，
暴雨將淹沒整個世界，
村莊和人們都將葬身水底~

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
The old lady's curse made the moon furious~
Get rid of the old lady to calm the moon~
If only the old lady wasn't here, If only the old lady wasn't here...
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的男人]
老婦人的詛咒激怒了月亮~
趕走老婦人，平息月亮的怒火~
要是老婦人不在就好了，要是她不在就好了......

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
I hear rumors~
The old lady threw herself into the lake~
the old lady, now turned into a dragon, will swallow the moon
and soon swallow the village too~
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的男人]
我聽說啊~
老婦人跳進了湖裡~
她如今變成惡龍，
要吞掉月亮，很快也會吞掉村莊~

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
You say the legend is all a lie?
You mean my ancestors are all liars
and swindlers?
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的男人]
你說傳說全是假的？
你是說我的祖先都是騙子，
都是欺詐之徒？

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
This village is built on an old legend
and history.
They are not the kind of people that will be shaken by
foolish words of an imbecile such as yourself.
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的男人]
這座村莊建立在古老的傳說
與歷史之上。
我們可不會被你這種蠢貨的
胡言亂語動搖。

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
Bakonawa that live at a lake,
story of an old lady that became a dragon.
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的女人]
住在湖裡的巴庫納瓦，
還有老婦人變成惡龍的故事。

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
The son that was suppose to return after the moon sets for the 90th time
never did come back even after the moon had set for a few hundred times~
The moon has swallowed the old lady's son~
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的女人]
那個本該在月亮落下第九十次時回來的兒子，
即使月亮落下了幾百次，還是沒有回來~
月亮吞掉了老婦人的兒子~

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
The moon, the moon, you shall receive the old lady's curse~
The whole village was immersed in death
with rain and floods sent by the furious moon~
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的女人]
月亮啊，月亮啊，你將承受老婦人的詛咒~
憤怒的月亮降下暴雨與洪水，
整個村莊都陷入死亡的深淵~

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
The moon, the moon, be still and be calm,
for the old lady is gone and she is no more~
The old lady has drowned in the lake~
She will transform into Bakonawa and come back...
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的女人]
月亮啊，月亮啊，安靜下來，平息怒火吧，
老婦人已經離去，不復存在~
老婦人淹死在湖裡~
她將化作巴庫納瓦，重返人間......

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
...to swallow you and
punish the village soon~
The day the moon dies
is the day the village dies too~
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的女人]
......把你吞下，
很快就會懲罰整個村莊~
月亮死去的那天，
也是村莊滅亡之日~

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
The legends are all a lie?
Why do you say such nonsense?
Is there nothing
that is important for you to protect?
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的女人]
傳說全是謊言？
你為什麼要說這種胡話？
難道你沒有什麼
想要守護的珍貴之物嗎？

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
Poor Bakonawa...
I would be happy
if she took a big bite out of someone like you!
scripts.translation:
[歌唱的女人]
可憐的巴庫納瓦......
要是它能狠狠咬你一口，
我倒會很高興！

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Frightened Boy]
The vicious monster Bakonawa will soon come
to swallow the moon and take vengeance upon the village.
I'm scared, please help...
scripts.translation:
[驚恐的男孩]
可怕的魔物巴庫納瓦很快就要來了，
它要吞掉月亮，向村莊復仇。
我好害怕，請幫幫我......

scripts.text:
[Frightened Boy]
The legend of Bakonawa is all a lie?
So that means Bakonawa doesn't exist?
I'm going to play with my friends at the lake later.
You told me it was all a lie right?
scripts.translation:
[驚恐的男孩]
巴庫納瓦的傳說都是假的？
那就是說巴庫納瓦根本不存在？
我等會兒要去湖邊和朋友玩。
你剛才說那些都是假的，對吧？

scripts.text: - She seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 她似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
It is said that Bakonawa hates loud noises.
Pound the pot if you want to live!
scripts.translation:
[驚恐的少女]
據說巴庫納瓦討厭巨響。
想活命就敲鍋！

scripts.text: Hates loud noises?
scripts.translation: 它討厭巨響？

scripts.text: What is Bakonawa?
scripts.translation: 巴庫納瓦是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
You already heard that the old lady
died and became Bakonawa, right?
scripts.translation:
[驚恐的少女]
你已經聽說那位老婦人死後變成巴庫納瓦的事了吧？

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
The legend has it that
the old lady had very keen hearing
because she was always focusing on
the returning of her traveling son.
scripts.translation:
[驚恐的少女]
傳說那位老婦人聽力特別敏銳，
因為她總是專心等待
遠行的兒子歸來。

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
So naturally, Bakonawa also
has very keen hearing.
The reason why everyone is banging
pots and pans is because of this.
scripts.translation:
[驚恐的少女]
所以巴庫納瓦自然也有
敏銳的聽覺。
大家拼命敲打鍋碗瓢盆，
就是因為這個。

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
It is a terrible monster that lives at a lake.
We are all trembling with fear
because we don't know when it might attack the village.
scripts.translation:
[驚恐的少女]
它是棲息在湖中的可怕魔物。
我們都嚇得發抖，
不知道它什麼時候會襲擊村莊。

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
Some say that it is more obsessed with swallowing the moon
than attacking the village.
if that's the case, I wish it would just swallow the moon
and leave us alone.
scripts.translation:
[驚恐的少女]
有人說，比起襲擊村莊，
它更執著於吞掉月亮。
如果真是這樣，我倒希望它乾脆吞了月亮，
然後別來煩我們。

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
The villagers hate you now.
You've been saying that legend of Bakonawa
is a lie and they are saying you are more of a monster
than Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[驚恐的少女]
村民們現在都很討厭你。
你一直說巴庫納瓦的傳說是假的，
他們覺得你比巴庫納瓦更像魔物。

scripts.text: - Old Fortune Teller seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 年邁的占卜師似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Old Fortune Teller]
You must not hate Bakonawa.
The hate against it is only feeding its rage
to grow bigger.
scripts.translation:
[老占卜師]
你不該憎恨巴庫納瓦。
人們對它的憎恨只會助長它的怒火，
讓怒火越燒越旺。

scripts.text:
[Old Fortune Teller]
To calm the dead lady's anger,
we annually hold a ceremony and prepare food.
But there seems to be no way to calm the
ever growing anger of the old lady.
scripts.translation:
[老占卜師]
為了平息那位老婦人的怨恨，
我們每年都會舉行儀式、準備供品。
可老婦人的怨恨似乎與日俱增，
我們已經找不到平息它的辦法了。

scripts.text:
[Old Fortune Teller]
The day is nearing. I can sense it.
Bakonawa will soon swallow the moon
and come to punish the village.
scripts.translation:
[老占卜師]
那一天就快到了，我能感覺到。
巴庫納瓦很快就會吞掉月亮，
前來懲罰村莊。

scripts.text:
[Old Fortune Teller]
How can you say the legend is a lie!
Because of you, the fury of Bakonawa
grew even larger!
If the village perishes,
it is all your fault!
scripts.translation:
[老占卜師]
你怎麼能說傳說是假的！
都是因為你，巴庫納瓦的怒火
才變得更加強烈！
要是村莊毀滅了，
全都是你的錯！

scripts.text: You cannot start the conversation. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品過多，無法開始對話。 -

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
There is something that needs to be done
but you look too fragile
to give me a hand.
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
有件事非做不可，
可你看起來太弱了，
幫不了我。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Come back when
your strength grows strong enough
to match Incubus.
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
等你強到能和夢魘對抗時，
再回來吧。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The old lady has come back
to life as Bakonawa.
Soon she will come to take vengeance on the village.
We must calm her
if to prevent further destruction...
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
那位老婦人已經化作巴庫納瓦復活了。
她很快就會回來向村莊復仇。
為了避免更多破壞，
我們必須平息她的怒火......

scripts.text: Calm Bakonawa?
scripts.translation: 平息巴庫納瓦的怒火？

scripts.text: Further destruction?
scripts.translation: 避免更多破壞？

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The old lady faced an unjust death
because of villagers' selfishness.
She was a caring mother who loved her
son dearly.
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
那位老婦人因村民的自私而含冤死去。
她是一位慈愛的母親，深愛著自己的兒子。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
If we track the whereabouts of her son and hold a ritual
with her son's belongings,
her restless soul will be calmed
and she will spare us from destruction.
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
如果我們查明她兒子的下落，
用他留下的遺物舉行儀式，
就能安撫他母親不安的靈魂，
讓她不再毀壞村莊。

scripts.text:
[Villagers]
It is no use sir!!
scripts.translation:
[村民們]
先生，沒用的！！

scripts.text:
[Villagers]
You cannot stop the monster that way!
scripts.translation:
[村民們]
那樣根本阻止不了魔物！

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Of course, it will not be easy to track down the whereabouts of a person
who has been gone for a hundred years.
...
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
當然，要追查一個失蹤百年的人的下落，
絕非易事。
......

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Still, don't you think
it is worth a try?
Please help us and save us from our misery.
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
不過，你不覺得值得一試嗎？
求你幫幫我們，救大家脫離苦難。

scripts.text: It is no use.
scripts.translation: 這沒用的。

scripts.text: I'll help.
scripts.translation: 我來幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Yes, you are also right.
You are up against not a human,
but a monster.
Still, I trust in that old lady's
good heart.
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
是啊，你說得也有道理。
你要面對的不是人，而是魔物。
不過，我依然相信那位老婦人心底的善良。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Will you do it?
According to the legend,
the old lady's son was limping
and was a traveling merchant that sold wooden dolls.
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
你願意幫忙嗎？
傳說那位老婦人的兒子是個跛腳的旅行商人，
專門販賣木偶。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
There is a ^FF0000Slate Piece^000000 he left.
But the piece is small and damaged,
its hard to identify it.
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
他留下了一塊^FF0000石板碎片^000000。
碎片又小又破損，
很難辨認。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
First, bring it to me.
Down along this path
you will meet my granddaughter near the port.
Get the Slate Piece from there.
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
先把它帶給我。
沿著這條路往下走，
你會在港口附近遇到我的孫女。
去找她拿石板碎片。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The grudge against the people of
Bakonawa- I mean, the dead old lady.
The moon and this village...
She will try to destroy it.
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
她對巴庫納瓦——我是說，對那位已故老婦人的怨恨。
對月亮和這座村莊的怨恨......
她想毀掉這一切。

scripts.text: Take vengeance? After all these years?
scripts.translation: 這麼多年過去了，她還要復仇？

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
For some time, she has
blamed the moon and
resented the villagers.
The feeling grew larger as the time passed.
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
有一段時間，她一直責怪月亮，
也怨恨村民。
隨著歲月流逝，這份怨恨愈發強烈。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Why do you think she became such a monster?
What do you think went through her head
for years and years?
Anger and vengeance.
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
你覺得她為何會變成這樣的魔物？
你想想她這麼多年來心裡想著什麼？
是憤怒，是復仇。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Unforgettable grudge
that she was abandoned.
against the moon and the village.
This is why this grudge must be resolved.
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
她被拋棄後留下的刻骨怨恨，
指向月亮，也指向村莊。
所以我們必須化解這份怨恨。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Please bring the ^FF0000Slate Piece^000000.
Down along this path
you will meet my granddaughter near the port.
Get the Slate Piece from there.
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
請把^FF0000石板碎片^000000帶來。
沿著這條路往下走，
你會在港口附近遇到我的孫女。
去找她拿石板碎片。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Good, you have the Slate Piece.
Hold on to it and don't lose it.
It will be of helpful in tracking down the legend.
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
很好，你拿到石板碎片了。
收好，別弄丟。
調查這段傳說時會用得上。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
I heard there is a man that lives by himself
at the end of northwestern part of Forest Field.
I heard someone saw a wooden doll there.
It is such a remote place that people like us
simply cannot travel there.
Could you visit the place for us?
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
我聽說森林西北盡頭住著一個獨居的男人。
有人還說在那裡見過木偶。
那個地方實在太偏遠，我們這種人根本去不了。
你能替我們去看看嗎？

scripts.text: Go there yourself!
scripts.translation: 你自己去！

scripts.text: Your explanation is too vague.
scripts.translation: 你說得也太含糊了。

scripts.text: On my way!
scripts.translation: 我這就去！

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
You twisted youth!
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
你這個不知好歹的小子！

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
You have a point, but
this is the best I can do for now.
The place is at the end of northwestern part of the forest.
After you pass the bridge and travel west,
you will see a person.
Good luck to you... for our sake...
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
你說得有道理，不過我現在只能告訴你這麼多了。
那個地方在森林西北盡頭。過橋後往西走，就能看到一個人。
祝你好運......為了我們......

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
You have a good heart young man!
The place is at the end of northwestern part of the forest.
After you pass the bridge and travel west,
You will see a ^0000FFMalaya Immigrant^000000.
Good luck to you... for our sake...
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
你真是個善良的年輕人！
那個地方在森林西北盡頭。過橋後往西走，
你會看到一位^0000FF馬來移民^000000。
祝你好運......為了我們......

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The place is at the end of northwestern part of the forest.
After you pass the bridge and travel west,
you will see a person.
Good luck to you... for our sake...
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
那個地方在森林西北盡頭。過橋後往西走，
你就會看到一個人。
祝你好運......為了我們......

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The track of the old lady's son
is connected all the way to
Baryo Mahiwaga?
There is a chance he wasn't a merchant...
I'm really curious about who he was...
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
老婦人的兒子的線索，
竟然一路指向
巴里奧·馬希瓦加？
說不定他根本不是商人......
我真想知道他究竟是誰......

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Why did you come back here
instead of going straight to
Baryo Mahiwaga?
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
你為什麼沒直接去
巴里奧·馬希瓦加，
反而回到這裡來了？

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Is that really true?
Bakonawa turning into an old lady
and fabricating the legend...
It seems all the villagers up until now
have been manipulated by that terrible monster.
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
這是真的嗎？
巴庫暴龍變成老婦人，
還編造了那段傳說......
看來這麼多年來，村民們
一直被那隻可怕的魔物矇騙了。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
There is no reason to hesitate then.
You must go into Bakonawa's lair
before it attacks first.
I believe we can trust you to do this, yes?
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
既然如此，就沒什麼好猶豫的了。
你必須趕在巴庫暴龍襲擊之前，
進入它的巢穴。
這件事就拜託你了，好嗎？

scripts.text: Well...
Of course!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The atmosphere was really good
but suddenly it's all ruined.
I didn't expect you to be so shy...
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
氣氛本來好好的，
突然全被你破壞了。
沒想到你這麼害羞......

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
I will speak to
the village chief for you
so that you can enter the Bakonawa Lake.
Please get rid of this monster for us.
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
我會替你向村長說明，
讓你進入巴庫納瓦湖。
請替我們除掉這隻魔物。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
If you don't mind,
could you lend a hand to the Village Chief?
Nobody cares for each other anymore
because of Bakonawa...
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
如果你不介意，
能幫村長一把嗎？
巴庫暴龍害得大家
都不再關心彼此了......

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The legend that
we believed for a hundred years,
all lies....
Please get rid of this monster for us.
scripts.translation:
[老傳說講述者]
我們信了一百年的傳說，
竟然全是謊言......
請替我們除掉這隻魔物。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
You must have a brave heart
to come to such a remote place.
How is Port Malaya these days?
I heard the monster that lives at the lake, Baknoawa
is threatening the villagers.
I am in the dark about what is going on because I'm here all the time.
scripts.translation:
[馬來移民]
你一定很勇敢，
才會來到這麼偏遠的地方。
最近馬來港怎麼樣？
我聽說湖裡的魔物巴庫暴龍
正在威脅村民。
我一直待在這裡，對那邊的情況不太瞭解。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
You must have a brave heart
to come to such a remote place.
How is Port Malaya these days?
I heard the monster that lives at the lake, Baknoawa
is threatening the villagers.
I am in the dark about what is going on because I'm here all the time.
scripts.translation:
[馬來移民]
你一定很勇敢，
才會來到這麼偏遠的地方。
最近馬來港怎麼樣？
我聽說湖裡的魔物巴庫暴龍
正在威脅村民。
我一直待在這裡，對那邊的情況不太瞭解。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
Are you the traveling merchant who used to sell Wooden Doll, right?
I don't know about any traveling merchant, but by Wooden Doll
(going through things) do you mean this?
I don't know about the specifics, but
I think it's related to what I heard long time ago.
scripts.translation:
[馬來移民]
你是以前賣木偶的旅行商人吧？
我不認識什麼旅行商人，不過你說的木偶......
（翻找東西）是這個嗎？
具體情況我不太清楚，
但這讓我想起很久以前聽過的一件事。

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼住在這裡？

scripts.text: Do you know about this Slate Piece?
scripts.translation: 你知道這塊石板碎片的事嗎？

scripts.text: Please tell me the story.
scripts.translation: 請把那個故事告訴我。

scripts.text: Who is the traveling merchant?
scripts.translation: 那個旅行商人是誰？

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
I liked the environment here
so I decided to stay and live.
There is no obligation here.
To me, that's as good as heaven.
scripts.translation:
[馬來移民]
我喜歡這裡的環境，
所以決定留下來生活。
這裡沒有束縛，
對我來說簡直像天堂。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
It is a very old Slate Piece.
I'm sorry but I never seen this before.
There is some kind of writing here
but I can't make it out.
scripts.translation:
[馬來移民]
這是一塊很古老的石板。
抱歉，我以前沒見過它。
上面好像刻著一些字，
但我看不懂。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
It's a simple story.
^0000FFA wounded man who I had never seen before^000000
^0000FFcame to my house and asked for help.^000000
^0000FFOnce healed, he made a Wooden Doll^000000
scripts.translation:
[馬來移民]
故事很簡單。
^0000FF一個我從未見過的受傷男人^000000
^0000FF來到我家求助。^000000
^0000FF傷好之後，他做了一個木偶^000000

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
^0000FFthat is suppose to chase away evil spirits ^000000
^0000FFas a token of gratitude,^000000
^0000FFand left for Baryo Mahiwaga.^000000
scripts.translation:
[馬來移民]
^0000FF據說那個木偶可以驅趕惡靈，^000000
^0000FF他把它當作謝禮，^000000
^0000FF隨後就去了巴里奧·馬希瓦加。^000000

scripts.text: He left for Baryo Mahiwaga?
scripts.translation: 他去了巴里奧·馬希瓦加？

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
According to what I've heard
that's correct. But the story has been
passed on from mouth to mouth for a
long time. I can't be sure.
scripts.translation:
[馬來移民]
我聽說是這樣。不過這故事口耳相傳了很久，
我也不能確定真假。

scripts.text:
From Baryo Mahiwaga village, using keyword ^0000FFMalaya^000000,
or ^0000FFBakonawa^000000,
maybe I could find out the identity and whereabouts
of the traveling merchant.
scripts.translation:
從巴里奧·馬希瓦加村民那裡打聽，
用^0000FF馬來亞^000000或^0000FF巴庫暴龍^000000作關鍵詞，
也許能查出那位旅行商人的身份和下落。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
Well, there is a lack of information
so I can't make say for sure but
I'm skeptical if he was in fact even a merchant.
Coming to a town with a
critical wound seems too suspicious...
scripts.translation:
[馬來移民]
嗯，知道的線索太少，我沒法確定。
不過我懷疑他真的是商人嗎？
身受重傷還來到城鎮，實在很可疑......

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
And craving a Wooden Doll
could be seen to have some kind of ritualistic meaning.
Protecting one from some evil force...
that kind of thing.
scripts.translation:
[馬來移民]
而且他執意要做一個木偶，
聽起來像是有什麼儀式用途，
比如用來抵禦邪惡力量......

scripts.text:
Identity of the traveling merchant...
Looks like there is one more
mystery to be solved.
I suppose it will all come to light
soon enough.
scripts.translation:
旅行商人的身份......
看來還有一個謎團等著解開。
我想很快就會水落石出。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
I will tell you again slowly
the story that has been passed on.
Listen carefully and repeat...
no, I mean, you don't have repeat it.
scripts.translation:
[馬來移民]
我再慢慢講一遍這個流傳下來的故事。
仔細聽，然後複述一遍......
不，我是說，不用複述。

scripts.text:
[Orally Transmitted Story]
^0000FFA wounded man who I had never seen before^000000
^0000FFcame to my house and asked for help.^000000
^0000FFOnce healed, as a token of gratitude, he made a Wooden Doll^000000
^0000FFthat is suppose to chase away evil sprits.^000000
^0000FFThen he left for Baryo Mahiwaga.^000000
scripts.translation:
[口述故事]
^0000FF一個我從未見過的受傷男人^000000
^0000FF來到我家求助。^000000
^0000FF傷好之後，為表謝意，他做了一個木偶，^000000
^0000FF據說那個木偶可以驅趕惡靈。^000000
^0000FF之後他就去了巴里奧·馬希瓦加。^000000

scripts.text:
From Baryo Mahiwaga village, using keyword ^0000FFMalaya^000000,
or ^0000FFBakonawa^000000,
maybe I could find out the identity and whereabouts
of the traveling merchant.
scripts.translation:
從巴里奧·馬希瓦加村民那裡打聽，
用^0000FF馬來亞^000000或^0000FF巴庫暴龍^000000作關鍵詞，
也許能查出那位旅行商人的身份和下落。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
Have you been to
Port Malaya?
I am curious to know
what is going on there
but I can't travel because there are monsters everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[馬來移民]
你去過馬來港嗎？
我很想知道那裡發生了什麼，
可週圍到處都是魔物，我沒法過去。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
Wooden Doll?
There is a tale related to that,
but you didn't come all the way
just to hear some folktale right?
scripts.translation:
[馬來移民]
木偶？
這倒是有個相關的故事，
不過你不會大老遠跑來就為了聽民間故事吧？

scripts.text: I just came here to take a break.
scripts.translation: 我只是來歇歇腳。

scripts.text: Tell me the tale.
scripts.translation: 把故事講給我聽。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
You must have a lot of free time on your hands!
I'm no travel agent
so go bother someone else!
scripts.translation:
[馬來移民]
你可真閒！
我又不是導遊，
去找別人問吧！

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
It's baloney
so I don't really remember the details.
scripts.translation:
[馬來移民]
都是胡說八道，
我記不太清細節了。

scripts.text:
[Summary of the folktale]
Long time ago, 5 swordsmen fought
against the monster Bakonawa.
Four died and one left a critical wound
to the monster but in return
sustained a serious wound in his leg himself.
scripts.translation:
[民間故事摘要]
很久以前，5名劍士
與魔物巴庫暴龍交戰。
四人戰死，另一人重創了魔物，
自己也因此
身負重傷，腿部傷勢尤為嚴重。

scripts.text:
[Summary of the folktale]
After escaping the scene, Bakonawa transformed into a human
and secretly pursued the swordsman.
The swordsman made a Wooden Doll that
can keep the monster from approaching.
scripts.translation:
[民間故事摘要]
逃離戰場後，巴庫暴龍變成人形，
暗中追蹤那名劍士。
劍士做了一個木偶，
用來阻止魔物靠近。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
This is the end of story.
Without any conclusion...
scripts.translation:
[馬來移民]
故事就這樣結束了。
沒有任何結局......

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
I heard there is a record that the swordsman left
but I don't understand why
he would leave it here in such a distant place
here instead of Malaya.
scripts.translation:
[馬來移民]
我聽說那名劍士留下了一份記錄，
但不明白他為何要把記錄留在
這麼偏遠的地方，
而不是留在馬來港。

scripts.text: I wish to see the record.
scripts.translation: 我想看看那份記錄。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
The record is engraved on the stone ahead.
However, the stone is so badly
damaged and some pieces fell out that
it will be hard to make the words out.
scripts.translation:
[馬來移民]
記錄刻在前面那塊石頭上。
不過石頭損毀嚴重，
有些碎片已經脫落，
上面的字很難辨認。

scripts.text: Investigate the stone ahead.
scripts.translation: 調查前面的石頭

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
The stone ahead holds a record that
a swordsman from a long time ago left.
scripts.translation:
[馬來移民]
前面的石頭上刻著
一名古代劍士留下的記錄。

scripts.text: Where did this swordsman go after?
scripts.translation: 那名劍士後來去了哪裡？

scripts.text: Tell me the tale again.
scripts.translation: 再給我講講那個故事。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
Well, there is no story after that so
I guess nobody would know what happened.
scripts.translation:
[馬來移民]
嗯，故事到這裡就沒了，
我想沒人知道後來發生了什麼。

[Summary of the folktale]

against the monster Bakonawa.
Four died and one left a critical wound
on the monster but in return
sustained a serious wound in his leg himself.

很久以前，5名劍士
與魔物巴庫暴龍交戰。
四人戰死，另一人重創了魔物，
自己也因此
身負重傷，腿部傷勢尤為嚴重。

After escaping the scene, Bakonawa transformed into a human

scripts.translation:
[民間故事摘要]
逃離戰場後，巴庫暴龍變成人形，
暗中追蹤那名劍士。
劍士做了一個木偶，
用來阻止魔物靠近。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
I suppose you wish to hear the story again right?
No problem! I can tell this story forever!
scripts.translation:
[馬來移民]
你是想再聽一遍故事吧？
沒問題！我可以一直講下去！

scripts.text:
[Summary of the folktale]
Long time ago, 5 swordsmen fought
against the monster Bakonawa.
Four died and one left a critical wound
on the monster but in return
sustained a serious wound in his leg himself.
scripts.translation:
[民間故事摘要]
很久以前，5名劍士
與魔物巴庫暴龍交戰。
四人戰死，另一人重創了魔物，
自己也因此
身負重傷，腿部傷勢尤為嚴重。

scripts.text:
[Summary of the folktale]
After escaping the scene, Bakonawa transformed into a human
and secretly pursued the swordsman.
The swordsman made a Wooden Doll that
can keep the monster from approaching.
scripts.translation:
[民間故事摘要]
逃離戰場後，巴庫暴龍變成人形，
暗中追蹤那名劍士。
劍士做了一個木偶，
用來阻止魔物靠近。

scripts.text:
The damage is so severe
that the record is unidentifiable.
When inserting the Slate Piece
to a hole on the wall, it fits perfectly like a piece of puzzle.
The letters are not clear but you can still read it.
scripts.translation:
記錄損毀得太嚴重，已經難以辨認。
你把石板碎片嵌進牆上的缺口，
嚴絲合縫，彷彿拼圖一般。
字跡雖然模糊，還是勉強能讀出來。

scripts.text:
[Record left by a swordsman from a hundred years ago]
After fighting with Bakonawa, I sustained a critical wound
and came to this place.
Only thing I can do is
Place the Wooden Doll in one place
the monster would come.
scripts.translation:
[百年前劍士留下的記錄]
在與巴庫暴龍交戰後，我身負重傷，
來到這個地方。
我唯一能做的，
就是把木偶放在
魔物可能出現的地方。

scripts.text:
[Record left by a swordsman from a hundred years ago]
^0000FFSometimes transforming into a child, or even a old lady,^000000
I know that ^0000FFBakonawa^000000has been
chasing after me in secret to kill me.
Because of that critical injury the monster * sustained,
scripts.translation:
[百年前劍士留下的記錄]
^0000FF它有時會變成孩子，甚至老婦人的模樣，^000000
我知道^0000FF巴庫暴龍^000000一直在暗中
追蹤我，想要殺死我。
因為魔物受了致命傷，

scripts.text:
[Record left by a swordsman from a hundred years ago]
** it will need nearly a hundred years
for Bakonawa to absorb the power of the moon
to fully recover its power.
Beware of the day the moon disappears.
scripts.translation:
[百年前劍士留下的記錄]
**巴庫暴龍需要將近一百年
吸收月亮的力量，
才能完全恢復。
當心月亮消失的那一天。

scripts.text:
[Record left by a swordsman from a hundred years ago]
The day will come when Bakonawa
will run amuck.
But it will take nearly a hundred years to fully recover its power.
There will always be someone better than me
to defeat the vile creature.
scripts.translation:
[百年前劍士留下的記錄]
巴庫暴龍肆虐的日子終將到來。
但它需要近百年才能完全恢復力量。
總會有比我更強的人
打倒這隻邪惡的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Record left by a swordsman from a hundred years ago]
I will place my trust in the one that will replace me ages from now...
scripts.translation:
[百年前劍士留下的記錄]
我願意相信，許多年後會有人接替我......

scripts.text:
How could this be...
Lie told by Bakonawa when it turned into an old lady
in order to take revenge on the swordsman
turned into a legend after all these years.
scripts.translation:
怎麼會這樣......
巴庫暴龍為了向劍士復仇，
化作老婦人編造了謊言。
這麼多年過去，那謊言竟成了傳說。

scripts.text:
I found out that Bakonawa
is nothing but a blood thirsty monster.
I must tell what I know to the ^0000FFOld Legend Teller^000000
in Malaya.
scripts.translation:
我發現巴庫暴龍
不過是嗜血的魔物。
我得去馬來港，把這一切告訴
^0000FF古老傳說的講述者^000000。

scripts.text:
Here is the record left by a swordsman
from a hundred years ago.
scripts.translation: 這是百年前一名劍士留下的記錄。

scripts.text: I don't need to read it.
scripts.translation: 我不用讀。

scripts.text: Read the record again.
scripts.translation: 再讀一遍記錄。

scripts.text:
I remember the story clearly.
Let's tell the ^0000FFOld Legend Teller^000000 in Malaya
about what I discovered.
scripts.translation:
我已經清楚記住故事了。
去馬來港把發現告訴^0000FF古老傳說的講述者^000000吧。

I found out that Bakonawa
is nothing but a blood thirsty monster.
I must tell what I know to the ^0000FFOld Legend Teller^000000
in Malaya.
scripts.translation:
我發現巴庫暴龍
不過是嗜血的魔物。
我得去馬來港，把這一切告訴
^0000FF古老傳說的講述者^000000。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Old Man's Granddaughter]
Grandpa believes
Bakonawa can
turn good.
Do you think it's possible?
scripts.translation:
[老人的孫女]
爺爺相信
巴庫暴龍能夠變好。
你覺得可能嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man's Granddaughter]
^FF0000Slate Piece^000000?
Why would you need something
that is barely recognizable?
I'll give it to you if you want.
scripts.translation:
[老人的孫女]
^FF0000石板碎片^000000？
這東西都破成這樣了，幾乎認不出來，
你要它做什麼？
你想要的話就拿去吧。

scripts.text:
Let's go to the
^FF0000Old Legend Teller^000000
now that I have the Slate Piece.
scripts.translation:
既然拿到了石板碎片，
現在就去見^FF0000古老傳說的講述者^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man's Granddaughter]
Please take this Slate Piece
and deliver it to my grandpa.
scripts.translation:
[老人的孫女]
請收下這塊石板碎片，
替我交給爺爺。

scripts.text:
Let's go to the
^FF0000Old Legend Teller^000000
now that I have the Slate Piece.
scripts.translation:
既然拿到了石板碎片，
現在就去見^FF0000古老傳說的講述者^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man's Granddaughter]
Because of Bakonawa,
the village is always unpeaceful.
scripts.translation:
[老人的孫女]
巴庫暴龍害得村子一直不得安寧。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Angry Man]
Calm Bakonawa?
Do you know how many people have been
sacrificed by Bakonawa?
I will fight on my own if I have to!
scripts.translation:
[憤怒的男人]
安撫巴庫暴龍？
你知道有多少人死在它手裡嗎？
必要的話，我會獨自去戰鬥！

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Calm Little Girl]
It is too dangerous to fight against
Bakonawa. There is a chance
it will get more angry and put children and
elders in danger.
scripts.translation:
[冷靜的小女孩]
和巴庫暴龍戰鬥太危險了。
它可能會變得更加憤怒，
讓孩子和老人陷入險境。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Angry Boy]
I lost my father and my friend
to that Bakonawa.
I will surely revenge them!
scripts.translation:
[憤怒的男孩]
我的父親和朋友都被巴庫暴龍害死了。
我一定要替他們報仇！

scripts.text: You cannot start the conversation. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品過多，無法開始對話。 -

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I'm desperate for a helping hand
but you look
too weak and fragile.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
我急需有人幫忙，
可你看起來
太弱不禁風了。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Please come back when
you grow strong enough
to match Incubus.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
等你變得足夠強，
能與夢魘匹敵時，
再回來吧。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I'm don't know what's the right decision.
To fight against Bakonawa,
or calm it by offering it a sacrificial gift.
Recently, there have been more people that have
been harmed by Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
我不知道該怎麼做才好。
是與巴庫暴龍戰鬥，
還是獻上祭品安撫它？
最近被巴庫暴龍傷害的人越來越多了。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The legend was all a lie?
It seems all the villagers up until now
were manipulated by that vile monster.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
傳說竟然全是謊言？
看來這麼多年來，村民們
一直被那隻邪惡的魔物矇騙了。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Recently, there have been more people that have
been harmed by Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
最近被巴庫暴龍傷害的人越來越多了。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
There are some missing villagers
but I can't find out if
they are simply missing or if they have been
killed by Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
有些村民失蹤了，
但我無法查明他們只是走失，
還是已經被巴庫暴龍殺害。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I heard that the belongings of the missing people
are being found at Baryo Mahiwaga Field.
Please go there to find ^0000FFLost Belongings^000000
and give them to the families of
the missing people
in whatever amount they want.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
我聽說失蹤者的遺物出現在巴里奧·馬希瓦加平原。
請去那裡找找^0000FF失物^000000，
再按失蹤者家屬的要求，把相應數量的物品交給他們。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
^0000FFLost Belongings^000000
are said to be carried by
^FF0000Tiyanak^000000 that roams Baryo Mahiwaga.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
^0000FF失物^000000據說被在巴里奧·馬希瓦加遊蕩的
^FF0000惡魔嬰兒^000000帶走了。

scripts.text: Do it yourself.
scripts.translation: 你自己去吧。

scripts.text: I'm on my way.
scripts.translation: 我這就去。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
You give me a lot to think about.
Leave the village at once.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
你讓我很失望。
馬上離開村子。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Let's start then. First,
retrieve two ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and take them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Father^000000
for me.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
那就開始吧。首先，
從惡魔嬰兒那裡找回兩件^FF0000失物^000000，
替我交給^0000FF失蹤者的父親^000000。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
From Tiyanak that roams Baryo Mahiwaga Field,
retrieve two ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Father^000000
for me.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
從遊蕩在巴里奧·馬希瓦加平原的惡魔嬰兒那裡，
找回兩件^FF0000失物^000000，
替我交給^0000FF失蹤者的父親^000000。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Retrieve Seven ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Friend^000000
for me.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
從惡魔嬰兒那裡找回七件^FF0000失物^000000，
替我交給^0000FF失蹤者的朋友^000000。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Retrieve three ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Son^000000
for me.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
從惡魔嬰兒那裡找回三件^FF0000失物^000000，
替我交給^0000FF失蹤者的兒子^000000。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Retrieve five ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Mother^000000
for me.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
從惡魔嬰兒那裡找回五件^FF0000失物^000000，
替我交給^0000FF失蹤者的母親^000000。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
So it's clear that all the missing people
have been killed by Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
看來所有失蹤的人
都被巴庫暴龍殺害了。

scripts.text:
[Villagers]
Kill Bakonawa!
Let's get rid of the monster ourselves!
scripts.translation:
[村民們]
殺了巴庫暴龍！
我們自己動手消滅那隻魔物！

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
It seems we would no longer be able to
hold rituals to calm Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
看來我們再也沒法
舉行儀式安撫巴庫暴龍了。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Young Fortune Teller is looking for your help
saying that the energy of the moon seems strange.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
年輕的占卜師說月亮的能量似乎有些異常，
她正在找你幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Young Fortune Teller is looking for your help
saying that the energy of the moon seems strange.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
年輕的占卜師說月亮的能量似乎有些異常，
她正在找你幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I know that terrible things happened
long time ago when the moon disappeared.
I hope the moon recovers its strength
with your devoted effort.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
我知道很久以前月亮消失時，
發生過可怕的事情。
希望在你的努力下，
月亮能恢復力量。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I will tell the
Young Fortune Teller to help you.
But before that, there is
something you must do immediately.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
我會讓年輕的占卜師來幫你。
不過，在那之前，
有件事你必須立刻去辦。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
We never know when Bakonawa will attack
the village so we must set traps near the village
entrance and near the cave.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
我們不知道巴庫暴龍何時會襲擊村莊，
所以得在村口和洞穴附近設定陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I would be grateful if you help us.
I have dispatched workers
near where traps will be set up,
so you just have to visit about 5 places.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
如果你能幫忙，我會非常感激。
我已經派工人到陷阱設定點附近，
你只要去大約五個地方看看就行。

scripts.text: Sounds like too much work.
scripts.translation: 聽起來太麻煩了。

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 沒問題。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
This operation means life and death to us
yet you refuse it easily as if
it was some kind of a chore...
scripts.translation:
[村長]
這事關我們的生死存亡，
你卻把它當成瑣事，輕易就拒絕了......

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
What a hero!
scripts.translation:
[村長]
真是個英雄！

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The first trap will be set up at
Baryo Mahiwaga Field
near the village entrance. ^0000FFGruffy Worker^000000
will be waiting for you. He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
第一個陷阱會設在靠近村口的
巴里奧·馬希瓦加平原。^0000FF粗聲工人^000000會在那裡等你，他會幫上大忙。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The first trap will be set up at
Baryo Mahiwaga Field
near the village entrance. ^0000FFGruffy Worker^000000
will be waiting for you. He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
第一個陷阱會設在靠近村口的
巴里奧·馬希瓦加平原。^0000FF粗聲工人^000000會在那裡等你，他會幫上大忙。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The second trap will be set up
near a place where it connects from
Baryo Mahiwaga Field to Bakonawa Lake.
^0000FFGrumpy Worker^000000
will be waiting for you. He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
第二個陷阱會設在巴里奧·馬希瓦加平原通往巴庫納瓦湖的路口附近。
^0000FF暴躁工人^000000會在那裡等你，他會幫上大忙。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The third trap will be set up
near Bakonawa Lake Entrance.
^0000FFCowardly Worker^000000
will be waiting for you. He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
第三個陷阱會設在巴庫納瓦湖入口附近。
^0000FF膽小工人^000000會在那裡等你，他會幫上大忙。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The fourth trap will be set up
near the entrance of Bakonawa Lake as well.
^0000FFGloomy Worker^000000 will be waiting for you.
He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
第四個陷阱也會設在巴庫納瓦湖入口附近。
^0000FF憂鬱工人^000000會在那裡等你，他會幫上大忙。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The fifth trap will be set up
near the entrance of Bakonawa Lake too.
^0000FFSentimental Worker^000000
will be waiting for you. He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
第五個陷阱同樣會設在巴庫納瓦湖入口附近。
^0000FF多愁善感的工人^000000會在那裡等你，他會幫上大忙。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
It looks like the traps are all set up.
We just finished our village meeting on
what to do about Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
看來陷阱都設定好了。
我們剛結束關於如何應對巴庫暴龍的村民會議。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
We have concluded that
we will fight against Bakonawa.
Please help us by
attacking his lair.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
我們已經決定與巴庫暴龍戰鬥。
請幫幫我們，去襲擊它的巢穴。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Would you visit ^0000FFOld Legend Teller^000000
when you have a chance?
I think you would be able to help him.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
有空的話，請去拜訪^0000FF古老傳說的講述者^000000。
我想你能幫上他的忙。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Please think of the countless victims
and defeat Bakonawa
for their sake.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
請為了無數受害者，
打倒巴庫暴龍。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Thank you.
Please think of the countless victims
and defeat Bakonawa
for their sake.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
謝謝你。
請為了無數受害者，
打倒巴庫暴龍。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Father]
Please find our
child.
Bakonawa would have not harmed our child.
He must be around here somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的父親]
請幫忙找找我們的孩子。
巴庫暴龍不會傷害我們的孩子。
他一定就在附近某處。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Father]
You are looking for two of his ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000?
Are you confident that
he already died?
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的父親]
你要找他兩件^FF0000失物^000000？
你確定他已經死了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Father]
This... is our child's ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
for sure.
The monster got to him after all....
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的父親]
這......肯定是我們孩子的^FF0000失物^000000。
終究還是被那隻魔物抓走了......

scripts.text:
The man is unable to continue as he tries to hold back his tears.
Let's continue to find the lost belongings of the missing people.
Let's retrieve them from Tiyanak that roams Baryo Mahiwaga Field,
seven ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Friend^000000.
scripts.translation:
男子強忍淚水，已經說不下去了。
我們繼續尋找其他失蹤者的遺物吧。
從巴里奧·馬希瓦加平原遊蕩的惡魔嬰兒那裡找回七件^FF0000失物^000000，
交給^0000FF失蹤者的朋友^000000。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Father]
My baby... my poor baby...
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的父親]
我的孩子......我可憐的孩子......

scripts.text:
The man is unable to continue as he tries to hold back his tears.
Let's continue to find the lost belongings of the missing people.
Retrieve seven ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Friend^000000.
scripts.translation:
男子強忍淚水，已經說不下去了。
我們繼續尋找其他失蹤者的遺物吧。
從惡魔嬰兒那裡找回七件^FF0000失物^000000，
交給^0000FF失蹤者的朋友^000000。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Father]
My baby... my poor baby...
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的父親]
我的孩子......我可憐的孩子......

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Friend]
Please find
my friend.
We were playing ball together
and suddenly my friend disappeared.
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的朋友]
請幫我找找我的朋友。
我們本來在一起玩球，
他突然就不見了。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Friend]
I'm sure he is alive and well
somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的朋友]
我相信他一定還活著，
就在某個地方。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Friend]
You are looking for seven ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
of my friend?
My friend is not dead!
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的朋友]
你要找我朋友的七件^FF0000失物^000000？
我朋友沒有死！

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Friend]
These are marbles and toys I gave him...
These are clearly ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
of my friend... Where is my friend?
Bring him here, bring him here now!
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的朋友]
這些彈珠和玩具都是我送給他的......
這些肯定是我朋友的^FF0000失物^000000......他在哪兒？
把他帶回來，現在就把他帶回來！

scripts.text:
Leaving behind the crying boy,
let's continue to find the lost belongings of the missing people.
Retrieve three ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Son^000000.
scripts.translation:
留下哭泣的男孩，
繼續尋找其他失蹤者的遺物吧。
從惡魔嬰兒那裡找回三件^FF0000失物^000000，
交給^0000FF失蹤者的兒子^000000。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Friend]
Bring back my friend!
Bring back my friend now!
My friend is alive,
It's all a lie, sob~
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的朋友]
把我朋友還回來！
現在就把他帶回來！
我朋友還活著，
這都是騙人的，嗚......

scripts.text:
Leaving behind the crying boy,
let's continue to find the lost belongings of the missing people.
Retrieve three ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Son^000000.
scripts.translation:
留下哭泣的男孩，
繼續尋找其他失蹤者的遺物吧。
從惡魔嬰兒那裡找回三件^FF0000失物^000000，
交給^0000FF失蹤者的兒子^000000。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Son]
Bakonawa has hurt my father?
I can't believe this.
Please find my father!
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的兒子]
巴庫暴龍傷害了我父親？
我不敢相信。
求你幫我找到父親！

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Son]
You are looking for three ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
of my father? Why lost belongings and not my father?
No, that can't be it. He is alive somewhere!
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的兒子]
你要找我父親的三件^FF0000失物^000000？為什麼找的是遺物，不是我父親？
不，不可能。他一定還活著！

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Son]
These are clearly his clothes and shoes...
These are ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 of my father.
Oh dear lord... father!
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的兒子]
這些明明是他的衣服和鞋子......
這是我父親的^FF0000失物^000000。
天啊......父親！

scripts.text:
Man crying in agony.
Let's continue to find the lost belongings of the missing people.
Retrieve five ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Mother^000000.
scripts.translation:
男子悲痛欲絕。
繼續尋找其他失蹤者的遺物吧。
從惡魔嬰兒那裡找回五件^FF0000失物^000000，
交給^0000FF失蹤者的母親^000000。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Son]
Why did such a thing happen....
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的兒子]
為什麼會發生這種事......

scripts.text:
Man crying in agony.
Let's continue to find the lost belongings of the missing people.
Retrieve five ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Mother^000000.
scripts.translation:
男子悲痛欲絕。
繼續尋找其他失蹤者的遺物吧。
從惡魔嬰兒那裡找回五件^FF0000失物^000000，
交給^0000FF失蹤者的母親^000000。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Mother]
Please find my child.
I sent her out to do a chore
and she still isn't back.
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的母親]
求你幫我找找孩子。
我讓她出門辦點事，
她到現在還沒回來。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Mother]
You are looking for five ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 of my child?
What does this mean?
Are you saying my child is dead?
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的母親]
你要找我孩子的五件^FF0000失物^000000？
這是什麼意思？
你是說我的孩子死了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Mother]
This is my child's hair comb.
Why do you have five ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 of my child?
Why...? She's... dead?
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的母親]
這是我孩子的梳子。
為什麼你會拿著她的五件^FF0000失物^000000？
為什麼......她......死了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Mother]
No wait... I think I hear her voice.
She's going to be home soon. I should go home now.
I should prepare a dinner for her. She must be starving.
Ha ha...
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的母親]
不，等等......我好像聽見她的聲音了。
她很快就回家了。我也該回家了。
得給她準備晚飯，她一定餓壞了。
哈哈......

scripts.text:
A mother that has gone mad...
Now that I finished finding the missing people,
I should report back to the Village Chief.
scripts.translation:
一位已經精神失常的母親......
既然失蹤者的線索都查過了，
我該回去向村長報告。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Mother]
Ha ha ha... I can hear my child's voice,
just listen closely.
Can't you hear her calling her mother?
Ha ha ha...
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的母親]
哈哈哈......我聽得見孩子的聲音，
你仔細聽聽。
難道沒聽見她在叫媽媽嗎？
哈哈哈......

scripts.text: A mother that has gone mad...
scripts.translation: 一位已經精神失常的母親......

scripts.text:
A mother that has gone mad...
Now that I finished finding the missing people,
I should report back to the Village Chief.
scripts.translation:
一位已經精神失常的母親......
既然失蹤者的線索都查過了，
我該回去向村長報告。

scripts.text: You cannot start the conversation. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品過多，無法開始對話。 -

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
The energy of the moon grew weak.
The reason there are more monsters,
and the reason there are more victims,
is all because of this.
scripts.translation:
[年輕占卜師]
月亮的能量變弱了。
魔物變多、受害者增加，
都是因為這個。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
The energy of the moon grew weak for a couple of days.
The reason there are more monsters,
and the reason there are more victims, is all because of this.
scripts.translation:
[年輕占卜師]
這幾天月亮的能量一直在減弱。
魔物變多、受害者增加，
都是因為這個。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
I'm trying to hold a ritual
that will restore the moon's energy by sacrificing monsters' blood,
so I need you to hunt fifteen ^FF0000Tikbalang^000000
at Baryo Mahiwaga Field.
scripts.translation:
[年輕占卜師]
我正打算舉行儀式，獻上魔物之血來恢復月亮的能量。
所以需要你去巴里奧·馬希瓦加平原獵殺15只^FF0000邪魔馬^000000。

scripts.text: It's none of my business.
scripts.translation: 這不關我的事。

scripts.text: You can count on me.
scripts.translation: 交給我吧。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
You are so selfish!
During the ritual,
I will pray for your bad luck too.
scripts.translation:
[年輕占卜師]
你真自私！
儀式期間，我也會祈禱讓你倒霉。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
Hurry.
If the moon completely disappears,
there will be a great disaster.
scripts.translation:
[年輕占卜師]
快點。
要是月亮完全消失，
就會釀成大災難。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
It looks like you took care of ^FF0000Tikbalang^000000
well enough.
I think I can start the ritual now.
There are some items that we need, please go to
the Village Chief for help.
scripts.translation:
[年輕占卜師]
看來你已經把^FF0000邪魔馬^000000處理得差不多了。
我想現在可以開始儀式了。
我們還需要一些東西，去找村長幫忙吧。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
I need you to hunt fifteen ^FF0000Tikbalang^000000
at Baryo Mahiwaga Field.
scripts.translation:
[年輕占卜師]
去巴里奧·馬希瓦加平原獵殺15只^FF0000邪魔馬^000000。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
Hurry.
If the moon completely disappears,
there will be a great disaster.
scripts.translation:
[年輕占卜師]
快點。
要是月亮完全消失，
就會釀成大災難。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
I think I can start the ritual now.
There are some items that we need, please go to
the Village Chief for help.
scripts.translation:
[年輕占卜師]
我想現在可以開始儀式了。
我們還需要一些東西，去找村長幫忙吧。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
On the day when the moon fully disappears,
the dragon will attack the village.
No one will be safe.
scripts.translation:
[年輕占卜師]
月亮完全消失的那天，
惡龍就會襲擊村莊。
到時候誰也逃不掉。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
The Village Chief told me to
wait for you here.
scripts.translation:
[粗暴的工人]
村長讓我在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
The trap will be set right in front.
Walk forward a little.
scripts.translation:
[粗暴的工人]
陷阱就設在前面。
再往前走幾步。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
You can find the
Grumpy Worker near where
Baryo Mahiwaga Field connects to Bakonawa Lake.
Go and set up the trap together.
scripts.translation:
[粗暴的工人]
去巴里奧·馬希瓦加平原通往巴庫納瓦湖的路口附近，找暴躁工人。
和他一起把陷阱設好。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
Are you trying to advertise that
there is a trap here? Step aside.
scripts.translation:
[粗暴的工人]
你是在故意告訴大家這裡有陷阱嗎？讓開。

scripts.text:
I should set up the trap
right about here.
scripts.translation: 我就在這裡佈置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
Using the tools like this
bang bang bang!
scripts.translation:
[粗暴的工人]
像這樣用工具——
砰砰砰！

scripts.text: bang bang bang!
scripts.translation: 砰砰砰！

scripts.text: The trap is now set.
scripts.translation: 陷阱佈置好了。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
You can find the
Grumpy Worker near where
Baryo Mahiwaga Field connects to Bakonawa Lake.
Go and set up the trap together.
scripts.translation:
[粗暴的工人]
去巴里奧·馬希瓦加平原通往巴庫納瓦湖的路口附近，找暴躁工人。
和他一起把陷阱設好。

scripts.text: The trap has been set up here.
scripts.translation: 這裡已經佈置好陷阱了。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
This trap is not meant to capture you,
so move.
scripts.translation:
[粗暴的工人]
這陷阱又不是用來抓你的，
快讓開。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
You can find the
Grumpy Worker near where
Baryo Mahiwaga Field connects to Bakonawa Lake.
Go there to him.
scripts.translation:
[粗暴的工人]
去巴里奧·馬希瓦加平原通往巴庫納瓦湖的路口附近找暴躁工人。

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
Village Chief told me to
wait for you here.
Sooo boring!
scripts.translation:
[暴躁的工人]
村長叫我在這裡等你。
無聊死了！

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
A hole needs to be dug up in front of here?
I have to dig too?
Says who?
scripts.translation:
[暴躁的工人]
要在前面挖個坑？
我也得挖？
誰說的？

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
Go find the Cowardly Worker
near the entrance of Bakonawa Lake.
Come on, move it!
scripts.translation:
[暴躁的工人]
去巴庫納瓦湖入口附近找膽小工人。
快點，動起來！

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
I set up the trap
and you are advertising that it's here.
Scram!
scripts.translation:
[暴躁的工人]
陷阱是我設的，
你卻站在這兒告訴大家陷阱的位置。
滾開！

scripts.text:
I should set up the trap
right about here.
scripts.translation: 我就在這裡佈置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
I really don't like it here!
...
With this pickax,
dig dig dig!
scripts.translation:
[暴躁的工人]
我真討厭這裡！
......
拿這把鎬子，
挖、挖、挖！

scripts.text: dig dig dig!
scripts.translation: 挖、挖、挖！

scripts.text: The trap is now set.
scripts.translation: 陷阱佈置好了。

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
Go find the Cowardly Worker
near the entrance of Bakonawa Lake.
Come on, move it!
scripts.translation:
[暴躁的工人]
去巴庫納瓦湖入口附近找膽小工人。
快點，動起來！

scripts.text: The trap has been set up here.
scripts.translation: 這裡已經佈置好陷阱了。

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
Are you trying to test
with your body if the trap works?
Move aside!
scripts.translation:
[暴躁的工人]
你是想親自試試陷阱靈不靈嗎？
快讓開！

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
Go find the Cowardly Worker
near the entrance of Bakonawa Lake.
Come on, move it!
scripts.translation:
[暴躁的工人]
去巴庫納瓦湖入口附近找膽小工人。
快點，動起來！

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Village Chief told me to
wait for you here.
Why me? I have a bad feeling about this....
scripts.translation:
[膽小的工人]
村長叫我在這裡等你。
為什麼偏偏是我？我總覺得要出事......

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
set up a trap in front of here?
Village Chief said I have to help too?
Can you please do it by yourself?
scripts.translation:
[膽小的工人]
要在前面佈置陷阱？
村長說我也得幫忙？
你能不能自己弄好？

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Go up and you will
find the Gloomy Worker.
Go! You scare me.
You look like you are going to beat me up.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的工人]
往上走就能找到憂鬱工人。
快去！你讓我害怕，
看起來像是要揍我似的。

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Go away!
What if Bakonawa
appears because of you?
I'm scared to death!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的工人]
走開！
你在這裡的話，巴庫納瓦說不定會出現！
我快嚇死了！

scripts.text:
I should set up the trap
right about here.
scripts.translation: 我就在這裡佈置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
There is nothing weird
buried here right?
...
Using the shovel, dig dig dig!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的工人]
這裡沒埋什麼奇怪的東西吧？
......
用鏟子挖、挖、挖！

scripts.text: dig dig dig!
scripts.translation: 挖、挖、挖！

scripts.text: The trap is now set.
scripts.translation: 陷阱佈置好了。

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Go up and you will
find the Gloomy Worker.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的工人]
往上走就能找到憂鬱工人。

scripts.text: The trap has been set up here.
scripts.translation: 這裡已經佈置好陷阱了。

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Step aside immediately!
Bakonawa might find out this is a trap
and come for us.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的工人]
馬上讓開！
巴庫納瓦可能會發現這是陷阱，然後來找我們算賬。

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Go up and you will
find the Gloomy Worker.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的工人]
往上走就能找到憂鬱工人。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
Village Chief told me to wait for you here.
He must want me to do something.
Whew...
scripts.translation:
[憂鬱的工人]
村長叫我在這裡等你。
他肯定有事要我做。
唉......

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
set up a trap on the left side?
I don't think it will be much use...
Whew, I should've moved away or something...
scripts.translation:
[憂鬱的工人]
要在左邊設陷阱？
我覺得沒什麼用......
唉，我真該早點搬走......

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text: Nurse Maenne?
scripts.translation: 護士梅恩？

scripts.translation:

有隻兇惡的魔物在這家醫院裡遊蕩。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Hmmmm...
It's not exactly a monster....
More like a curse or disease...
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
嗯......
嚴格來說，它不算魔物......
更像是詛咒，或某種疾病......

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
There's a story saying that it used to be a wood fairy.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
有個傳說說，它以前是森林妖精。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Anyway, it doesnt change the fact that she killed the patients of this hospital and turned them into monsters.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
不過，無論如何，她殺害了這家醫院的病人，還把他們變成了魔物，這一點不會改變。

scripts.text: Nurse Maenne
scripts.translation: 護士梅恩

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Me?
As you can see, I'm the new nurse here.
I'm a nurse who specializes in 'this' kind of work, instead of looking after patients.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
我？
如你所見，我是這裡的新護士。
我不負責照顧病人，而是專門處理“這類”事情。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Oh!
The Bangungot pretended to be me?
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
哦！
般滾勾特假扮成我了？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Seeing how much it rattled you.
It's a rather smart one.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
看你被嚇成這樣，就知道它還挺聰明的。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Simply said, I cure unnatural phenomenon around hospitals.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
簡單來說，我負責處理醫院周圍發生的超自然現象。

scripts.translation:
[護士]

scripts.text:
There's a nurse outside the hospital holding a large bag.
I don't think I can help her.
scripts.translation:
醫院外有位護士提著一個大袋子。
我覺得自己幫不上她。

[Nurse]
Hey, hold on.
Are you planning on going inside?
scripts.translation:
[護士]
喂，等一下。
你打算進去嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不是。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Oh~
I'm so glad!
I was literally waiting all day for someone to some by.
scripts.translation:
[護士]
哦~
太好了！
我等了一整天，就盼著有人路過呢。

scripts.translation: 關於醫院

scripts.translation: 你為什麼攔著我？

This hospital is the only one in town.

這家醫院是鎮上唯一的一家。
而且我馬上就要在這裡上班了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
I heard it was just built, but it seems so creepy....
scripts.translation:
[護士]
聽說醫院才剛建好，可看起來陰森森的......

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
I was surprised when I got here too.
It says 'closed' all around it!
scripts.translation:
[護士]
我剛到這裡時也嚇了一跳。
四周到處都貼著“關閉”的告示！

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
I was told that they needed nurses in this town,
so I came here after turning down numerous proposals.
scripts.translation:
[護士]
我聽說鎮上缺護士，
於是拒絕了不少工作邀請，特地趕來這裡。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
I'd heard they were really cautious of outsiders...
scripts.translation:
[護士]
我聽說這裡的人對外來者特別戒備......

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Not even a soul to welcome me, let alone a party!
Shocking!
scripts.translation:
[護士]
別說歡迎派對了，連一個來迎接我的人都沒有！
真讓人震驚！

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
What's more, I made it here after being lost and now I'm facing a creepy and locked hospital!

更別提我迷路半天才找到這裡，結果眼前卻是這家陰森森又鎖著門的醫院！

scripts.translation:
[護士]
你這麼一說......如果你也要進去，能不能帶我一起？

My bags are heavy!
And my legs are killing me.
scripts.translation:
[護士]
門鎖著！
行李又重！
我的腿也快累斷了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
If I knew this was going to happen, I would've worn ER night-shift shoes instead of first-day shoes... *sniff*
scripts.translation:

早知道會這樣，我就該穿急診夜班的鞋，而不是第一天上班的新鞋......*抽鼻子*

scripts.translation: 幫她

*Sob*

You are too kind.
scripts.translation:

看來這個世界還是值得活下去的。
你人真好。

By the looks of it, though, I may become jobless...

[護士拉斯]
我們先想辦法進去吧。

Could you get something to wrap my feet? I can't put my shoes on because I've got blisters.
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
不過在那之前......
能幫我找些東西包住腳嗎？我腳上磨出了水泡，穿不了鞋。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
2 Rotten Bandages should do to wrap both my feet. They may look dirty, but they have special liquid on them that have amazing effects.
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
兩條腐爛繃帶應該夠包住我的雙腳。雖然看著很髒，上面卻有種效果驚人的特殊藥液。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Rotten Bandages... A fit name for something that seems to have been cut fresh from a mummy.
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
腐爛繃帶......名字真貼切，看起來就像剛從木乃伊身上撕下來的。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
I'm having second thoughts looking at them, but as I am to be a professional nurse!!

Ewwww!!
scripts.translation:

豁出去了！！！
嘔——！！

*Squelch*

*咕嘰*

腳舒服多了，不過這味道真怪。

好！！！
不知道門是鎖住了還是卡住了，我們一起推推看！

scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
旅館？
天哪！
要是他們早點告訴我，我就不用在外面站這麼久了！

scripts.text:

Hey... you know what...

[Nurse Las]

scripts.translation:

我的腳疼得走不動了。你能替我去趟旅館嗎？

How can this be?????
????
scripts.translation:

奇怪~！
門沒有鎖？
怎麼會這樣？？？？
？？？？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]

scripts.translation:

一切都亂套了。
也許我們該等醫生來......

A few days ago, the old lady who lives near us went around the hospital sticking some kind of sticks into the ground.
scripts.translation:
[不明人士]
幾天前，住在附近的老婦人繞著醫院走，把一些像棍子一樣的東西插在地上。

scripts.text:
[???]
She was mumbling and looking around a lot.
scripts.translation:
[不明人士]
她嘴裡一直唸唸有詞，還不停地東張西望。

scripts.text:
[???]
I was well hidden here because I wasn't supposed to be here.
scripts.translation:
[不明人士]
我本來就不該來這裡，所以一直藏得很好。

scripts.text:
[???]
My mom once told me.
The old lady's daughter was hospitalized here.
scripts.translation:
[不明人士]
媽媽以前跟我說過，那位老婦人的女兒曾在這家醫院住院。

scripts.text:

[不明人士]

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Okay, off you go.
I think she lives on the west side of town.
Go on.
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
好啦，出發吧。
我想她住在鎮子西邊。快去吧。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Hey you in the bushes, I'll tell on you if you don't go home now!
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
躲在灌木叢裡的小傢伙，再不回家我就告訴你媽媽！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Why!?
Staying here won't solve anything.
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
為什麼？！
待在這裡也解決不了問題。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Okay, off you go.
I think she lives on the west side of town.
Go on.
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
好啦，出發吧。
我想她住在鎮子西邊。快去吧。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Hey you in the bushes, I'll tell on you if you don't go home now!
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
躲在灌木叢裡的小傢伙，再不回家我就告訴你媽媽！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
How'd it go?
Did you meet the old lady?
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
怎麼樣？
見到那位老婦人了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Oh by the way, when [{0}], you were gone, I tried the door.
It did open...
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
對了，你離開的這段時間裡，[{0}]，我試著推了推那扇門。
它居然打開了......

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
But the way to the 2nd floor was blocked.
I thought the door opening was a break through, but turns out it wasn't.
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
不過通往二樓的路被堵住了。
我還以為開門就是突破口，結果並沒有。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Anyway, the first floor door is open, so let's go inside.
Everything would be meaningless if the second floor door is not opened.
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
總之，一樓的門已經打開了，我們進去吧。
要是打不開二樓的門，之前做的事就全白費了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Anyway, the first floor door is open, so let's go inside.
Everything would be meaningless if the second floor door is not opened.
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
總之，一樓的門已經打開了，我們進去吧。
要是打不開二樓的門，之前做的事就全白費了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Could you check the 2nd floor door again in case I missed something?
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
你能再去檢查一下二樓的門嗎？說不定我漏看了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
A talisman and a person?
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
護符和一個人？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
A talisman?
I think you should search for something else.
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
護符？
我覺得你該找找別的東西。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
A shaman... Best if we met her.
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
薩滿...最好能見見她。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Oh!
Speaking of talismans, wouldn't that old lady know about them, since she put some around the hospital?
I think it'll be a good idea to ask her.
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
哦！
說到護符，那位老太太在醫院周圍貼了不少，她應該知道些什麼吧？
我覺得去問問她比較好。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
I did see the talisman but I didn't go near it because I got a bad feeling about it.
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
我確實看見了那張護符，但總覺得不太對勁，所以沒敢靠近。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
It would've been easier if she was apart from her body, but now that she returned to her room, this is going to be a little tricky.
scripts.translation:
[護士梅安妮]
要是她和身體分開時動手會容易些，但她現在已經回到房間，事情就有點棘手了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Of course, don't you dare walk away from this, since you disturbed my job and led her to her room.
scripts.translation:
[護士梅安妮]
當然，你可別想就這麼走掉。你打擾了我的工作，還把她引回了房間。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
She may have rooted here deeper than I thought.
I can still feel her presence.
scripts.translation:
[護士梅安妮]
她在這裡紮根的程度可能比我想像的還深。
我仍能感受到她的存在。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
What you killed was a part of her...
But, it was a big help since you confused and damaged her at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[護士梅安妮]
你殺掉的只是她的一部分...
不過，你同時擾亂並削弱了她，這幫了大忙。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Oh!
You must have met her.
I feel something strong...
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
哦！
你一定遇見她了。
我感覺到一股強大的氣息...

scripts.text: Tell her about the talisman.
scripts.translation: 告訴她護符的事

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
If you make it to the 2nd floor door, I'll open a small door to her room for you.
After that, she's all yours.
scripts.translation:
[護士梅安妮]
你到二樓的門口後，我會替你開啟通往她房間的小門。
之後就交給你了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
*Sigh*...
I thought it strange when you were standing behind me....
scripts.translation:
[護士梅安妮]
*嘆氣*...
我就覺得奇怪，你怎麼一直站在我身後....

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Yes!
I have an idea.
How about we stick that one over the one we saw on the 2nd floor door?
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
好！
我想到辦法了。
把那張護符貼在二樓門上那張的上面怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Enter the hospital.
scripts.translation: 進入醫院

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
It makes things a lot easier.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[護士梅安妮]
這樣事情就容易多了。
謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Maybe it will block the bad energy it's giving out.
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
也許這樣就能擋住它散發出的邪氣。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Oh!
Speaking of talismans, wouldn't that old lady know about them, since she put some around the village?
I think it'll be a good idea to ask her.
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
哦！
說到護符，那位老太太在村子周圍貼了不少，她應該知道些什麼吧？
我覺得去問問她比較好。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[護士梅安妮]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
I didn't think you'd do something like this.
scripts.translation:
[護士梅安妮]
我沒想到你會做出這種事。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
We were just about to enter Bangungot's room, before we were thrown out...
scripts.translation:
[護士梅安妮]
我們剛要進入般滾勾特的房間，就被趕了出來...

scripts.text: Bangungot?
scripts.translation: 般滾勾特？

scripts.text: Nurse Maenne?
scripts.translation: 護士梅安妮？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
It's a vicious monster roaming this hospital.
scripts.translation:
[護士梅安妮]
它是徘徊在這家醫院裡的兇惡魔物。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Hmmmm...
It's not exactly a monster....
More like a curse or disease...
scripts.translation:
[護士梅安妮]
嗯...
也不能算是魔物...
更像是詛咒或疾病...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
There's a story saying that it used to be a wood fairy.
scripts.translation:
[護士梅安妮]
有個傳說說，它以前是木之精靈。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Anyway, it doesnt change the fact that she killed the patients of this hospital and turned them into monsters.
scripts.translation:
[護士梅安妮]
無論如何，她殺害了這家醫院的病人並把他們變成魔物，這一點不會改變。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Me?
As you can see, I'm the new nurse here.
I'm a nurse who specializes in 'this' kind of work, instead of looking after patients.
scripts.translation:
[護士梅安妮]
我？
如你所見，我是這裡新來的護士。
我不負責照顧病人，而是專門處理“這種”事情。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Oh!
The Bangungot pretended to be me?
scripts.translation:
[護士梅安妮]
哦！
般滾勾特假扮成我了？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Seeing how much it rattled you.
It's a rather smart one.
scripts.translation:
[護士梅安妮]
看你被嚇成這樣...
那傢伙還挺聰明的。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Simply said, I cure unnatural phenomenon around hospitals.
scripts.translation:
[護士梅安妮]
簡單來說，我負責處理醫院周圍的超自然現象。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Many things happen in the world.
scripts.translation:
[護士梅安妮]
世上總會發生各種各樣的事。

scripts.text: Nurse Maenne
scripts.translation: 護士梅安妮

scripts.text: Bangungot
scripts.translation: 般滾勾特

scripts.text:

- and try again. -

[Nurse]
I want to be left alone.
Please leave.
scripts.translation:
[護士]
我想一個人靜靜。
請離開。

scripts.text:
There's a talisman similar to the ones outside the hospital.
Let's look around for something else.
scripts.translation:
這裡有一道符咒，和醫院外面的那些很像。
再找找周圍吧。

scripts.text:

scripts.text: After sticking on the talisman over the other one, the dark feeling lifted away, just like Las said.
scripts.translation: 把這道符咒貼到另一道上後，陰冷的感覺消失了，和拉斯說的一樣。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
*Snigger*
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
*竊笑*

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Yes, yes!
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
沒錯，沒錯！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
The annoying talismans are gone!
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
那些討厭的符咒終於不見了！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
*Giggle*
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
*咯咯笑*

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Human's are so dumb. You show them a pretty little helpless look and they fall for it.
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
人類真好騙。只要裝出一副可憐兮兮的樣子，他們就會上鉤。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
*Snigger*
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
*竊笑*

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
For your work, I shall take you to my room...
Darn...
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
看在你幫忙的份上，我帶你去我的房間......
可惡......

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
......

[Nurse Las]
No no no!
You still have those annoying talismans!!!
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
不，不，不！
你身上還帶著那些討厭的符咒！！！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
This is your lucky day!
*Snigger*
scripts.translation:
[護士拉斯]
今天算你走運！
*竊笑*

scripts.text:
Cannot feel anything evil about the talisman.
Only the bitter taste of being fooled around Las remains...
scripts.translation:
符咒上已經感覺不到邪氣了。
只剩下被拉斯戲弄後的苦澀......

scripts.translation: 打聽她女兒的事

scripts.text:
[Bent Old Lady]
Everybody was happy to hear about the hospital being built.
scripts.translation:
[駝背老婦人]
聽說要建醫院時，大家都很高興。

scripts.text:
[Bent Old Lady]
We no longer had to go to other towns for medical care.
scripts.translation:
[駝背老婦人]
我們終於不用再跑去別的鎮看病了。

scripts.text:
[Bent Old Lady]
But the one they built didn't work out so well.
It couldn't cure people.
I knew this would happen when they chopped down the old tree to build it.
scripts.translation:
[駝背老婦人]
可建成的醫院並不如人意。
它治不好病人。
他們砍掉那棵老樹蓋醫院時，我就知道會出事。

scripts.text:
[Bent Old Lady]
But the administrator wouldn't listen.
Far from curing people, they started to die.
So did my daughter...
scripts.translation:
[駝背老婦人]
可管理員根本不聽。
醫院非但沒能治好病人，病人反而開始死去。
我的女兒也是......

scripts.text:
[Bent Old Lady]
She suffered from nothing life threatening.
It was...
Just a cold......
scripts.translation:
[駝背老婦人]
她得的根本不是什麼致命的病。
只是......
普通感冒......

scripts.text:
[Bent Old Lady]
The wicked thing.... My daughter...
There's something in that hospital.
scripts.translation:
[駝背老婦人]
那個邪惡的東西......我的女兒......
醫院裡有東西。

[Bent Old Lady]

That... That was a talisman to stop the wicked thing!
scripts.translation:
[駝背老婦人]

那......那是用來阻止邪惡之物的符咒！

scripts.text:
[Bent Old Lady]

scripts.translation:
[駝背老婦人]
要是把它們拔出來，那東西就會再次襲擊村民！

scripts.text:
[Bent Old Lady]
I saw it!
I saw it when they closed the hospital saying that everybody had died.
scripts.translation:
[駝背老婦人]
我親眼看見了！醫院宣佈所有人都死了、準備關閉時，我看見了。

scripts.text:
[Bent Old Lady]
But they all knew.
The patients weren't all dead.
scripts.translation:
[駝背老婦人]
可他們心裡都清楚，
病人並沒有全部死掉。

scripts.text:
[Bent Old Lady]

By the thing that took my daughter...
scripts.translation:
[駝背老婦人]
他們是被活著抓走的......
被那個奪走我女兒的東西抓走了......

scripts.text:
[Bent Old Lady]
Oh dear.
scripts.translation:
[駝背老婦人]

scripts.text:
Nurse Las may be in danger, standing alone in front of the hospital.
If I don't return quickly...
scripts.translation:

我得趕快回去......

I asked the shaman up north of the village to make them,
scripts.translation:

我請村子北邊的薩滿做了那些符咒。

Many adventurers helped find festival items that I returned to the village.

scripts.text:
[Isco]
Today's the first day of the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'. The festival is held for 7 days, so have fun.
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
今天是“^7A96E0彩繪節^000000”的第一天。慶典會持續7天，好好享受吧。

scripts.text:
[Isco]
Oh! Did you know?
Village tattooists draw tattoos only during the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'.

[伊斯科]
哦！你知道嗎？
村裡的紋身師只在“^7A96E0彩繪節^000000”期間幫人紋身。

scripts.text:
[Isco]
Today's the third day of the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
今天是“^7A96E0彩繪節^000000”的第三天。

scripts.text:
[Isco]
Villagers say that an adventurer named {0} got a tattoo at the festival.
scripts.translation:
[伊斯科]
村民們說，有位名叫{0}的冒險者在慶典上紋了身。

scripts.text:

in Baryo Mahiwaga called the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'.

scripts.text:
[Isco]
I don't think I'll make it to the festival this time.
scripts.translation:

我想這次是趕不上慶典了。

scripts.text: Why?

scripts.text:
