scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Why do you want a Tattoo?
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
你為什麼想紋身？

scripts.text: What is a Tattoo?
scripts.translation: 紋身是什麼？

scripts.text: I'm curious about the effect of Tattoos.
scripts.translation: 我想了解紋身有什麼效果。

scripts.text: I need a Tattoo.
scripts.translation: 我需要紋身。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
A Tattoo of a powerful monster is said to increase the ability of the holder.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
據說紋上強大魔物的圖案，持有者的能力就會增強。

scripts.text: Awesome. How can I get one?
scripts.translation: 太棒了。我要怎麼才能紋上？

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Drawing a Tattoo is a very holy task.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
紋身是一項神聖的儀式。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
10 Ancient Grudges to protect me while I draw Tattoos.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
紋身時需要10個遠古怨念來保護我。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
1 Doll that looks like a powerful monster.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
還需要1個強大魔物的玩偶。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
And last but not least, 1 Spirit Piece to imbue the energy of a powerful monster into the Tattoo.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
最後，也是最重要的，還需要1塊靈魂碎片，把強大魔物的力量注入紋身。

scripts.text: What kind of Tattoo will you draw?
scripts.translation: 你想紋哪種圖案？

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
I can draw 3 kinds of Tattoos.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
我可以紋三種圖案。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Bangungot Agimat Tattoo for a powerful monster that comes from an old gigantic tree in Port Malaya.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
般滾勾特護符紋身：以馬來港古老巨樹中的強大魔物為圖案。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Bakonawa Agimat Tattoo for a huge monster that can swallow the moon.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
巴庫暴龍護符紋身：以能夠吞下月亮的巨型魔物為圖案。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Buwaya Agimat Tattoo for a giant alligator that kidnaps people.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
寶箱巨鱷護符紋身：以會綁架人的巨鱷為圖案。

scripts.text: Where can I get the Spirit Pieces and Doll?
scripts.translation: 靈魂碎片和玩偶要去哪裡找？

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
You can get these powerful items from Buwaya, Bangungot, and Bakonawa themselves but it won't be an easy task.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
你可以直接從寶箱巨鱷、般滾勾特和巴庫暴龍身上取得這些強力物品，不過可不容易。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
This holy task isn't done every day. Tattoos are drawn only during the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
這項神聖儀式不是天天都能舉行的。只有在“^7A96E0彩繪節^000000”期間才能紋身。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Which Tattoo's effect are you curious about?
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
你想了解哪種紋身的效果？

scripts.text: Bangungot Agimat Tattoo
scripts.translation: 般滾勾特護符紋身

scripts.text: Buwaya Agimat Tattoo
scripts.translation: 寶箱巨鱷護符紋身

scripts.text: Bakonawa Agimat Tattoo
scripts.translation: 巴庫暴龍護符紋身

scripts.text: I have no questions.
scripts.translation: 我沒有其他問題。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Need 10 Ancient Grudges, 1 Piece of Bangungot's Spirit, and 1 Bangungot Doll to create
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
製作需要10個遠古怨念、1塊般滾勾特靈魂碎片和1個般滾勾特玩偶。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The Bangungot Agimat Tattoo holds the energy of an old gigantic tree in Port Malaya.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
般滾勾特護符紋身蘊含著馬來港古老巨樹的力量。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Increases the effect of healing others by 4% and healing from others by 7%.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
對他人的治療效果提高4%，受到他人治療時的恢復量提高7%。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Need 10 Ancient Grudges, 1 Piece of Buwaya's Spirit, and 1 Buwaya Doll to create
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
製作需要10個遠古怨念、1塊寶箱巨鱷靈魂碎片和1個寶箱巨鱷玩偶。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The Buwaya Agimat Tattoo contains the energy from a giant alligator.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
寶箱巨鱷護符紋身蘊含著巨鱷的力量。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Increases MATK by +7% and decreases Fixed Casting by 7%.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
魔法攻擊力提高7%，固定詠唱時間縮短7%。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Need 10 Ancient Grudges, 1 Piece of Bakonawa's Spirit, and 1 Bakonawa Doll to create
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
製作需要10個遠古怨念、1塊巴庫暴龍靈魂碎片和1個巴庫暴龍玩偶。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The Bakonawa Agimat Tattoo holds the energy from a gigantic monster that can swallow the moon.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
巴庫暴龍護符紋身蘊含著能夠吞下月亮的巨型魔物之力。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Increases ATK by +7% and ASPD by 10%.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
物理攻擊力提高7%，攻擊速度提高10%。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Looks like you've got all the answers. Hope you enjoy your journey.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
看來你已經瞭解清楚了。祝你旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Do you have any questions about other Tattoo effects?
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
你還想了解其他紋身的效果嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The holy task of drawing Tattoos is only done during the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'. Sorry but looks like the festival is not on.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
紋身這項神聖儀式只會在“^7A96E0彩繪節^000000”期間舉行。抱歉，現在不是慶典期間。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
You've come right on time during the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
你來得正是時候，現在正值“^7A96E0彩繪節^000000”。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
There is no time like during the holy '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000' to draw Tattoos.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
想紋身，沒有比神聖的“^7A96E0彩繪節^000000”期間更合適的時候了。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The festival doesn't last long so I should start drawing. What Tattoo do you need?
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
慶典持續不了多久，我得開始紋身了。你想紋哪種？

scripts.text: I will think it over.
scripts.translation: 我再考慮一下。

scripts.text: Bangungot Agimat Tattoo
scripts.translation: 般滾勾特護符紋身

scripts.text: Buwaya Agimat Tattoo
scripts.translation: 寶箱巨鱷護符紋身

scripts.text: Bakonawa Agimat Tattoo
scripts.translation: 巴庫暴龍護符紋身

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Hope you enjoy the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
祝你在“^7A96E0彩繪節^000000”玩得開心。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
I think you are short on materials.
Need 10 Ancient Grudges, 1 Piece of Bangungot's Spirit, and 1 Bangungot Doll to create a ^EE1D11Bangungot Agimat Tattoo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
看來你還缺少材料。
製作^EE1D11般滾勾特護符紋身^000000需要10個遠古怨念、1塊般滾勾特靈魂碎片和1個般滾勾特玩偶。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
I think you are short on materials.
Need 10 Ancient Grudges, 1 Piece of Buwaya's Spirit, and 1 Buwaya Doll to create a ^EE1D11Buwaya Agimat Tattoo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
看來你還缺少材料。
製作^EE1D11寶箱巨鱷護符紋身^000000需要10個遠古怨念、1塊寶箱巨鱷靈魂碎片和1個寶箱巨鱷玩偶。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
I think you are short on materials.
Need 10 Ancient Grudges, 1 Piece of Bakonawa's Spirit, and 1 Bakonawa Doll to create a ^EE1D11Bakonawa Agimat Tattoo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
看來你還缺少材料。
製作^EE1D11巴庫暴龍護符紋身^000000需要10個遠古怨念、1塊巴庫暴龍靈魂碎片和1個巴庫暴龍玩偶。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The materials are full with holy energy. I'm sure we'll get a great Tattoo using these.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
這些材料蘊含著神聖的力量。用它們一定能紋出很棒的圖案。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Please don't interrupt while I'm working on drawing a holy Tattoo if you want it to come out right.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
想讓神聖紋身順利完成，在我工作時就別打擾我。

scripts.text: The Tattooist placed the Ancient Grudges around the workplace.
scripts.translation: 紋身師把遠古怨念擺放在工作臺周圍。

scripts.text: The Ancient Grudge lit up and tools starts to glow. He smiled satisfyingly at the glowing tools and materials.
scripts.translation: 遠古怨念發出光芒，工具也開始閃耀。紋身師滿意地看著發光的工具與材料。

scripts.text: And then Bangungot stared intensely at the doll as if to remember every detail of it in his head.
scripts.translation: 隨後，般滾勾特緊盯著玩偶，彷彿要把每個細節都記在腦海裡。

scripts.text: And then Buwaya stared intensely at the doll as if to remember every detail of it in his head.
scripts.translation: 隨後，寶箱巨鱷緊盯著玩偶，彷彿要把每個細節都記在腦海裡。

scripts.text: And then Bakonawa stared intensely at the doll as if to remember every detail of it in his head.
scripts.translation: 隨後，巴庫暴龍緊盯著玩偶，彷彿要把每個細節都記在腦海裡。

scripts.text: Aren't you going to start?
scripts.translation: 你還不開始嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Oh no, now you ruined it.
I cannot draw a Tattoo for someone like you who doesn't understand art. You can take back the remaining materials.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
哎呀，你把儀式毀了。
我可不會給不懂藝術的人紋身。剩下的材料你拿回去吧。

scripts.text: Received back 5 Ancient Grudges, Bangungot Doll, and Piece of Bangungot's Spirit.
scripts.translation: 取回了5個遠古怨念、般滾勾特玩偶和般滾勾特靈魂碎片。

scripts.text: Received back 5 Ancient Grudges, Buwaya Doll, and Piece of Buwaya's Spirit.
scripts.translation: 取回了5個遠古怨念、寶箱巨鱷玩偶和寶箱巨鱷靈魂碎片。

scripts.text: Received back 5 Ancient Grudges, Bakonawa Doll, and Piece of Bakonawa's Spirit.
scripts.translation: 取回了5個遠古怨念、巴庫暴龍玩偶和巴庫暴龍靈魂碎片。

scripts.text: Think he will melt the doll with his eyes?
scripts.translation: 他是想用眼神把玩偶融化嗎？

scripts.text: He closed and opened his eyes slowly as if to memorize the doll in his head and then held up a glowing tool to start drawing.
scripts.translation: 他慢慢閉上又睜開眼，彷彿要把玩偶的模樣記在腦海裡，隨後舉起發光的工具開始繪製。

scripts.text: The Bangungot Tattoo was completed almost instantly.
scripts.translation: 般滾勾特護符紋身幾乎立刻就完成了。

scripts.text: The Buwaya Tattoo was completed almost instantly.
scripts.translation: 寶箱巨鱷護符紋身幾乎立刻就完成了。

scripts.text: The Bakonawa Tattoo was completed almost instantly.
scripts.translation: 巴庫暴龍護符紋身幾乎立刻就完成了。

scripts.text: But he kept on looking at each corner of the drawing as if he didn't like some of its details.
scripts.translation: 但他仍盯著圖案的各個角落，似乎對某些細節不太滿意。

scripts.text: Looks good to me.
scripts.translation: 我覺得挺不錯的。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Ergh! I told you not to interrupt!
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
呃！我說過別打擾我！

scripts.text: The Tattooist ripped up the drawing irritably.
scripts.translation: 紋身師惱怒地撕碎了畫稿。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
I can't continue like this. Maybe another time. You can take back the remaining materials.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
這樣我沒法繼續。改天再來吧。剩下的材料你可以拿回去。

scripts.text: Received back 5 Ancient Grudges, Bangungot Doll, and Piece of Bangungot's Spirit.
scripts.translation: 取回了5個遠古怨念、般滾勾特玩偶和般滾勾特靈魂碎片。

scripts.text: Received back 5 Ancient Grudges, Buwaya Doll, and Piece of Buwaya's Spirit.
scripts.translation: 取回了5個遠古怨念、寶箱巨鱷玩偶和寶箱巨鱷靈魂碎片。

scripts.text: Received back 5 Ancient Grudges, Bakonawa Doll, and Piece of Bakonawa's Spirit.
scripts.translation: 取回了5個遠古怨念、巴庫暴龍玩偶和巴庫暴龍靈魂碎片。

scripts.text: He looked at the drawing intensely for a long time and then nodded with a satisfied smile.
scripts.translation: 他凝視著畫稿許久，最後滿意地點了點頭。

scripts.text: Looks like he is satisfied with the Bangungot drawing.
scripts.translation: 看起來他對般滾勾特的紋身圖案很滿意。

scripts.text: Looks like he is satisfied with the Buwaya drawing.
scripts.translation: 看起來他對寶箱巨鱷的紋身圖案很滿意。

scripts.text: Looks like he is satisfied with the Bakonawa drawing.
scripts.translation: 看起來他對巴庫暴龍的紋身圖案很滿意。

scripts.text: But now he is staring at the sky without doing anything else. What is he waiting for?
scripts.translation: 可現在他只是仰望天空，什麼也不做。他在等什麼？

scripts.text: When will it be done?
scripts.translation: 什麼時候才能完成？

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Ergh! I told you not to interrupt!
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
呃！我說過別打擾我！

scripts.text: The Tattooist ripped up the drawing irritably.
scripts.translation: 紋身師惱怒地撕碎了畫稿。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
I can't continue like this. Maybe another time. You can take back the remaining materials.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
這樣我沒法繼續。改天再來吧。剩下的材料你可以拿回去。

scripts.text: Received back 5 Ancient Grudges, Bangungot Doll, and Piece of Bangungot's Spirit.
scripts.translation: 取回了5個遠古怨念、般滾勾特玩偶和般滾勾特靈魂碎片。

scripts.text: Received back 5 Ancient Grudges, Buwaya Doll, and Piece of Buwaya's Spirit.
scripts.translation: 取回了5個遠古怨念、寶箱巨鱷玩偶和寶箱巨鱷靈魂碎片。

scripts.text: Received back 5 Ancient Grudges, Bakonawa Doll, and Piece of Bakonawa's Spirit.
scripts.translation: 取回了5個遠古怨念、巴庫暴龍玩偶和巴庫暴龍靈魂碎片。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
.

. .
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
. .

. . .

. . . . . . .
The Tattooist's eyes started to shine after staring at the sky for awhile, then he broke the Piece of Bangungot's Spirit with both his hands.
scripts.translation: 紋身師望著天空許久，雙眼開始發亮，隨後雙手捏碎了般滾勾特的靈魂碎片。

scripts.text: The Tattooist's eyes started to shine after staring at the sky for awhile, then he broke the Piece of Buwaya's Spirit with both his hands.
scripts.translation: 紋身師望著天空許久，雙眼開始發亮，隨後雙手捏碎了寶箱巨鱷的靈魂碎片。

scripts.text: The Tattooist's eyes started to shine after staring at the sky for awhile, then he broke the Piece of Bakonawa's Spirit with both his hands.
scripts.translation: 紋身師望著天空許久，雙眼開始發亮，隨後雙手捏碎了巴庫暴龍的靈魂碎片。

scripts.text: The Piece of Bangungot's Spirit is shattered into powder. The Tattooist's hands are glowing.
scripts.translation: 般滾勾特的靈魂碎片碎成了粉末。紋身師的雙手發出光芒。

scripts.text: The Piece of Buwaya's Spirit is shattered into powder. The Tattooist's hands are glowing.
scripts.translation: 寶箱巨鱷的靈魂碎片碎成了粉末。紋身師的雙手發出光芒。

scripts.text: The Piece of Bakonawa's Spirit is shattered into powder. The Tattooist's hands are glowing.
scripts.translation: 巴庫暴龍的靈魂碎片碎成了粉末。紋身師的雙手發出光芒。

scripts.text: Why did you break the pieces...
scripts.translation: 你為什麼要把碎片捏碎......

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Ergh! I told you not to interrupt!
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
呃！我說過別打擾我！

scripts.text: The glowing light from his hands faded away. He starred at his hands for a while and then ripped up the drawing irritably.
scripts.translation: 他手上的光芒漸漸消退。他盯著自己的手看了一會兒，隨後惱怒地撕碎了畫稿。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
I was this close to completing a wonderful piece but you ruined it. Not in a good mood. You can take the remaining materials.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
我差一點就能完成傑作了，結果被你毀了。我現在心情很差。剩下的材料你拿回去吧。

scripts.text: Received back 5 Ancient Grudges and the doll.
scripts.translation: 取回了5個遠古怨念和那個玩偶。

scripts.text: He held up the powder in both hands and then blew it onto the drawing.
scripts.translation: 他雙手捧起粉末，吹向畫稿。

scripts.text: All Ancient Grudges started to burn and then the glowing light from the Bangungot drawing faded away.
scripts.translation: 所有遠古怨念開始燃燒，隨後般滾勾特紋身圖案上的光芒漸漸消退。

scripts.text: All Ancient Grudges started to burn and then the glowing light from the Buwaya drawing faded away.
scripts.translation: 所有遠古怨念開始燃燒，隨後寶箱巨鱷紋身圖案上的光芒漸漸消退。

scripts.text: All Ancient Grudges started to burn and then the glowing light from the Bakonawa drawing faded away.
scripts.translation: 所有遠古怨念開始燃燒，隨後巴庫暴龍紋身圖案上的光芒漸漸消退。

scripts.text: Blinking light on top of the drawing.
scripts.translation: 畫稿上方閃爍著光芒。

scripts.text: Light faded away and the Bangungot drawing is no longer the simple one it was before.
scripts.translation: 光芒消退後，般滾勾特的紋身圖案不再像之前那樣簡單。

scripts.text: Light faded away and the Buwaya drawing is no longer the simple one it was before.
scripts.translation: 光芒消退後，寶箱巨鱷的紋身圖案不再像之前那樣簡單。

scripts.text: Light faded away and the Bakonawa drawing is no longer the simple one it was before.
scripts.translation: 光芒消退後，巴庫暴龍的紋身圖案不再像之前那樣簡單。

scripts.text: The Bangungot drawing looks as if it is... alive.
scripts.translation: 般滾勾特的紋身圖案看起來...彷彿活了過來。

scripts.text: The Buwaya drawing looks as if it is... alive.
scripts.translation: 寶箱巨鱷的紋身圖案看起來...彷彿活了過來。

scripts.text: The Bakonawa drawing looks as if it is... alive.
scripts.translation: 巴庫暴龍的紋身圖案看起來...彷彿活了過來。

scripts.text: The Tattooist is finally satisfied and is all smiles.
scripts.translation: 紋身師終於滿意了，笑容滿面。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Ha ha. It came out great.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
哈哈，完成得真漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
I'm sorry you had to wait for a long time. But it was worth it cause I haven't created a Tattoo of this quality in a long time.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
抱歉讓你等了這麼久，不過一切都值得。我已經很久沒做出品質這麼好的紋身了。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The ^EE1D11Bangungot Agimat Tattoo^000000 you've waited for is now completed.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
您等待已久的^EE1D11般滾勾特護符紋身^000000已經完成。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The ^EE1D11Buwaya Agimat Tattoo^000000 you've waited for is now completed.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
您等待已久的^EE1D11寶箱巨鱷護符紋身^000000已經完成。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The ^EE1D11Bakonawa Agimat Tattoo^000000 you've waited for is now completed.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
您等待已久的^EE1D11巴庫暴龍護符紋身^000000已經完成。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Hope you enjoy the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
祝你在“^7A96E0彩繪節^000000”玩得開心。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I came from afar and dropped everything to come and enjoy the 'Pintados Festival'.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我從遠方趕來，放下手頭的一切，就是為了參加“彩繪節”。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I don't regret visiting but...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我不後悔這一趟，不過......

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I don't like the Tattoo I got after all I've gone through to get it.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
費了這麼大勁才弄到的紋身，我其實並不喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I've looked at it in the light but I think the Tattooist made a mistake.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我對著光仔細看過了，覺得紋身師肯定弄錯了。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
This ruined my whole visit.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
這趟旅行全被毀了。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Tsk!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
嘖！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I heard of the 'Pintados Festival' and came all the way from Kunlun.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我聽說有“彩繪節”，特地從崑崙趕來。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Just in case you might think otherwise, this is a mask on my face and not a tattoo.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
先說清楚，我臉上戴的是面具，不是紋身。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hey, hear me. This isn't the Tattoo I wanted.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
喂，聽我說，這根本不是我想要的紋身。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I asked for a Bakonawa Tattoo but the more I look at it, this is Bangungot.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我明明要的是巴庫暴龍紋身，越看越覺得這像般滾勾特。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
No... you said that you wanted that one. Don't be so difficult.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
不是......明明是你說要這個的。別這麼難纏。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Don't you know that customer is king? Huh? Do you want a bad reputation?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
你不知道顧客就是上帝嗎？嗯？想落得個壞名聲嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Ugh... Can't believe this.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
唉......真不敢相信。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Ah... I can't work with customers like this.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
唉......這種客人我實在應付不了。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
How many times do I have to tell you, you said you wanted a Bangungot.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
我都說多少遍了，是你自己說要紋般滾勾特。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Ouch, my throat... Shouting will get me nowhere.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
嘶......嗓子好痛......光喊也解決不了問題。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
They say the Pintados Festival will only be held for one week.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
聽說 彩繪節只舉辦一週。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I came from Luoyang without knowing about the festival. Must be my lucky day.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我從洛陽來，之前不知道有慶典。看來今天真走運。

scripts.text: ba-dum-DUM- ba-dum-DUM
scripts.translation: 咚—噠—咚—咚—噠—咚

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
The Pintados Festival wouldn't be a festival without a drummer.
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年輕人]
沒有鼓手，彩繪節就不成其為慶典了。

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
Why don't you join?
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年輕人]
要不要也來一起玩？

scripts.text: ba-dum-DUM- ba-dum-DUM
scripts.translation: 咚—噠—咚—咚—噠—咚

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
The Pintados from Pintados Festival means painted in our language.
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年輕人]
在我們的語言裡，Pintados 的意思是“繪上圖案”。

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
So that is probably why we have people drawing special Tattoos during the festival.
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年輕人]
所以慶典期間大家會紋上特別的圖案，大概就是因為這個吧。

scripts.text: ba-dum-DUM- ba-dum-DUM
scripts.translation: 咚—噠—咚—咚—噠—咚

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
I don't remember it accurately, but they say the Pintados Festival was to celebrate a rich harvest.
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年輕人]
我記不太清了，不過據說 彩繪節是為了慶祝豐收。

scripts.text: ba-dum-TSH- ba-dum-TSH-
scripts.translation: 咚—噠—嚓—咚—噠—嚓—

scripts.text:
[Beat Catching Boy]
I always get energetic when I hear drums and sticks in a rhythmic beat.
scripts.translation:
[打鼓點的男孩]
每當聽見鼓棒敲出有節奏的鼓點，我就渾身來勁。

scripts.text:
[Beat Catching Boy]
ba-dum-TSH- ba-dum-TSH- So much fun!
scripts.translation:
[打鼓點的男孩]
咚—噠—嚓—咚—噠—嚓—真有意思！

scripts.text: ba-dum-TSH- ba-dum-TSH-
scripts.translation: 咚—噠—嚓—咚—噠—嚓—

scripts.text:
[Beat Catching Boy]
I may be using sticks to catch the beat right now but you never know if I'll grow big enough to play the drums, right?
scripts.translation:
[打鼓點的男孩]
我現在雖然只能用鼓棒打節奏，但說不定長大後就能真正打鼓了呢，對吧？
